prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a suburban street intersection on an overcast day. The road is marked with yellow lines and appears wet, suggesting recent rainfall. Several vehicles are present: a white sedan is stopped at the intersection, facing the camera, while a black SUV is positioned further ahead, also stationary. To the left, a silver pickup truck is stopped at the intersection, and to the right, a dark-colored SUV is parked near the sidewalk. Residential houses with various roof colors and styles line both sides of the street, with some featuring small front yards and trees. A stop sign is visible on the right side of the frame, indicating the traffic rules for this intersection.  As the video progresses, the white sedan begins to move forward, slowly crossing the intersection. The black SUV remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining its position at the center of the frame. The silver pickup truck on the left begins to move forward, and the dark-colored SUV on the right continues to stay parked, with no noticeable movement. The scene captures multiple vehicle interactions at a 4-way stop, illustrating typical right-of-way behavior. The wet road surface and overcast sky persist, contributing to the subdued ambiance of the scene. By the final frame, the white sedan has completed its crossing, and the silver pickup truck has advanced from its original position, while some other vehicles remain unchanged, maintaining the calm and quiet atmosphere of the residential area.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing the interaction between the vehicles and the stop sign.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a residential street. The road is initially marked with yellow lines down the center, indicating a two-lane street, but then it disappears. On the right side of the road, there is a white pickup truck parked near several orange traffic cones, which are placed to block off part of the street. The truck appears stationary, with a box on its bed. The reflection of the white hooded vehicle can be seen on the windshield as it passes by. A work zone is also visible on the right side of the road, clearly marked and bounded by a series of orange traffic cones. The surrounding area consists of houses with similar styles of architecture, some with visible driveways and garages. The houses are surrounded by lawns and trees, some of which are bare. The sky above is clear and blue.  As the video progresses, the white hooded vehicle moves forward, slowly clearing the area marked by the orange traffic cones. The vehicle's movement is steady and deliberate. The traffic cones remain stationary. The camera remains fixed, capturing the vehicle's departure and the gradual opening up of the road ahead, revealing more of the residential street lined with houses and trees. By the final frame, the truck has moved further down the street, a tree devoid of foliage is visible on the right, and the road is mostly clear of the traffic cones, showing a broader view of the neighborhood with fewer obstructions.

The windshield wipers are actively clearing rain from the glass. On the left side of the street, a yellow building with large windows and a sign reading "St. James Health Center" stands prominently. As the car moves forward, a white sedan drives ahead, and a silver sedan remains stationary on the right, as it is parked. The car shifts slightly to its right on the lane marked "right lane must turn right," revealing a row of bicycles parked near a railing on the right side along a pole with a "no-left-turn" sign. prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield at an intersection under a clear blue sky. The road is marked with double yellow lines, white lines, and traffic signals hang above the intersection. Orange traffic barriers are set up on the left of the double yellow lines, indicating ongoing roadwork. On the right side of the road, there's a grassy area with some trees. The left side of the intersection has more trees and a few more traffic barriers. As the video progresses, the traffic lights at the intersection are flashing red. Vehicles first come to a complete stop, and then proceed through the intersection in the order in which they arrived. The camera remains stationary throughout, capturing the scene from a first-person perspective. The surroundings include a mix of greenery and urban elements, with a sign for Scripps Memorial Hospital La Jolla visible in the distance. The overall atmosphere is calm and orderly, typical of a suburban intersection during daylight hours.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, positioned directly behind a UPS delivery truck on a quiet residential street. The street is lined with parked cars on both sides, including a white SUV on the right and a gray sedan on the left. The surrounding area features multi-story apartment buildings with light-colored facades, partially obscured by lush green trees that cast dappled shadows across the road. The sky above is partly cloudy, allowing patches of blue to peek through, suggesting a bright, sunny day. As the video progresses, a black sedan passes by in the opposite direction of the ego vehicle on the opposing lane. The rear lights of the UPS truck are flashing, indicating that it is stationary. The gray sedan also remains parked on the left side of the street. The white SUV remains stationary on the right side throughout the sequence. The ego vehicle temporarily enters the opposite lane to overtake a UPS delivery truck that is stopped ahead, passing by the parked cars and the apartment buildings, while the trees continue to provide shade and a serene backdrop. By the final frame, the ego vehicle has moved further down the street, with the gray sedan now completely out of view, and the UPS delivery truck still parked on the right side of the street.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the scene, emphasizing the parked vehicles, the apartment buildings, and the lush greenery. The camera remains steady, focusing on the interaction between the ego vehicle and the stationary UPS truck, highlighting the calm and orderly nature of the residential neighborhood.

The tree continues to sway slightly in the breeze, and the sun creates a lens flare effect on the windshield. The overall scene remains calm and serene, with more vehicles and a few pedestrians entering the camera view. By the end of the video, the same tranquil suburban setting is captured, with the ego car having passed further down the road, and the tree still swaying gently in the breeze under the bright sunlight. The camera view stays static throughout the video.

The road ahead has three lanes, with clear lane markings and a mix of left-turn and right-turn indicators. The scene is dimly lit by the car's headlights and scattered streetlights, creating a moody and atmospheric setting. A semi-truck is visible in the distance, its lights glowing faintly against the dark sky. To the right, a pedestrian crossing sign is visible, and a building or structure with a lit sign suggests a gas station or convenience store. The environment feels quiet and somewhat eerie due to the darkness and limited visibility.  As the video progresses, the car continues its journey along the highway, with additional vehicles occasionally appearing and disappearing into the headlights' reach. The streetlights continue to cast their glow, reflecting off the road surface, enhancing the sense of movement and depth. By the final frame, the car approaches an intersection, where traffic lights are visible, and the road markings become clearer, indicating the direction of travel. The overall scene conveys a sense of solitude and anticipation as the vehicle navigates the quiet, dimly lit road.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide-angle shot from inside a vehicle, capturing an intersection under a clear blue sky. The scene is bustling with traffic; several cars and SUVs are present, some moving slowly while others are stationary. Overhead, traffic lights hang above the roads, and utility lines crisscross the sky. On the left side of the intersection, a white building stands out, possibly a commercial establishment, while on the right, a red building with a distinctive architectural feature is visible. Trees line the sidewalks, adding greenery to the urban landscape. As the video progresses, a black SUV drives from right to the center of the intersection, where it collides with a black sedan approaching from the opposite direction. Both vehicles stop, and the front end of the black sedan is clearly shown to be heavily damaged.

prompt_en: A first-person view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a wide, two-lane road under a clear blue sky. The road is flanked by lush green trees on both sides, with some power lines running parallel with it. On the left side of the road, a grassy area with tall trees and a few cars waiting at a traffic signal in the distance. On the right side, the road curves gently, bordered by more trees and a grassy slope. The road markings are visible, including dashed white lines dividing the lanes and solid yellow lines marking the center. The overall scene suggests a suburban or semi-rural setting with minimal traffic. As the vehicle moves forward, it approaches an intersection where traffic lights become visible. The camera captures the gradual approach towards the traffic lights at the intersection, showing a green left-turn arrow for the left-turn only lane and red circular signals for the straight-through lanes. The white car in front of the ego vehicle turns left, visible on the same lane. The surroundings remain consistent with the initial frame, featuring the same trees, power lines, and distant buildings. The camera angle shifts slightly as the vehicle changes its lane on the left-turn arrow sign at the intersection, with the green traffic lights hanging above the road, showing to turn left.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a car, looking out through the windshield onto a quiet suburban street. The road is lined with parked cars on both sides, including a white SUV, a silver sedan, and a blue hatchback. The houses are modest, with some featuring light-colored siding and others having darker exteriors. Trees, primarily evergreens and deciduous varieties, line the street, casting dappled shadows across the asphalt. Two pedestrians can be seen walking along the sidewalk on the right side— one in a dark shirt and shorts and the other in a lighter top and jeans. The sky above is clear and bright blue, indicating a sunny day. Power lines run parallel to the street, adding to the suburban setting. As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward down the street. The camera angle remains fixed, capturing the view from the driver's perspective. The two pedestrians walking along the street continue their journey. The ego vehicle carefully drives past the road where a man is walking with a little girl on the right side. The car passes by the parked vehicles and continues along the tree-lined road, maintaining a steady pace. By the final frame, the car has moved further down the street, with the trees and houses still visible on either side, and the pedestrians have mostly disappeared from view.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a multi-lane road intersection under a clear blue sky. The road is flanked by trees on both sides, suggesting a suburban or semi-urban setting. A large semi-truck on the left two lanes over with "LIVE YOUR WAVE" on its side is prominently visible, partially obstructing the view. Several other vehicles, including cars and a red SUV, are visible ahead, waiting at the traffic light. The ego vehicle slows down to prepare to stop due to the red light ahead. As the video progresses, the vehicles to the left of the ego vehicle continue to move forward, taking a left turn at the intersection. The traffic light over the ego vehicle's lane remains red throughout the video. The surrounding environment remains consistent, with the trees and road markings clearly visible throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the ego vehicle seems to have come to a stop. The vehicles on the adjacent opposite side of the road move through the intersection in an orderly fashion, depicting a typical urban intersection with moderate traffic flow. A medium shot from a first-person perspective inside the vehicle.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, positioned at an intersection in a residential neighborhood on a sunny day. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, with clear blue skies overhead. The street is lined with parked cars on both sides, including a dark-colored sedan and a silver SUV on the left side of the lane. The buildings are two-story houses with light-colored siding, featuring multiple windows and balconies. Trees with lush green foliage are planted along the sidewalks, casting shadows on the pavement. Overhead, numerous power lines crisscross against the sky. A "do not enter" sign is visible near the left side of the frame, indicating restricted access.  As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward, slowly navigating through the quiet residential street. The camera angle remains steady, capturing the gradual shift in perspective as the vehicle advances. The parked cars remain stationary, and the trees continue to cast shadows on the road. The buildings and power lines stay in place, maintaining their positions under the bright sunlight. No significant actions or new objects appear. By the final frame, the ego vehicle turns left onto a street where a "do not enter" sign is posted ahead, indicating restricted access, with the same residential backdrop and consistent lighting conditions.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video captured from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a sunny suburban neighborhood. The dashboard is visible at the bottom of the frame, suggesting the camera is mounted on the windshield. The scene is illuminated by bright sunlight, casting long shadows across the asphalt. Large, leafy trees dominate the background, their branches spreading wide and creating a canopy over the street. Reflections of these trees are visible on the hood and windshield of the ego vehicle, adding depth to the scene.  On the left side, a white house with a sloped roof is partially obscured by the trees. A stop sign stands on the right side of the intersection, near the curb, where a few parked cars are visible. The road markings and traffic signs indicate various directions and restrictions for vehicles at the intersection. A one-way sign and a right-turn only sign are visible at different locations. A bicycle sign can be seen near the trees at the center of the intersection. A sidewalk is also visible on the left side of the intersection.  As the video progresses, the car begins to move forward through the intersection, navigating the roundabout. The trees continue to cast shadows over the road, and the stop sign remains stationary. The white house on the left becomes more prominent as the car moves closer to it. The road markings for the roundabout become clearer, guiding the driver's path. The scene remains calm, with no other vehicles or pedestrians visible, emphasizing the quiet, suburban environment.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from the dashboard of a vehicle traveling down a suburban street under a clear blue sky. The road is lined with trees and houses, creating a serene and residential atmosphere. On the right side of the street, a speed limit sign indicates 35 mph, and a fence runs parallel to the sidewalk. Several cars are visible ahead, including a black sedan and a silver SUV, both moving in the same direction as the camera. As the video progresses, a gray pickup truck enters the frame from the left lane, driving in the opposite direction of the ego vehicle. Shortly after, a white sedan appears from behind the pickup truck, moving in the same direction as the pickup truck in a different lane, which then exits the frame. The ego vehicle comes to a stop at a T-intersection, yielding to oncoming traffic from the opposite direction while preparing to make a left turn. The camera remains stationary, capturing the steady flow of traffic and the tranquil surroundings, with no significant changes in the environment or the actions of other vehicles. By the end of the video, the scene remains consistent with the initial view, showing the same road, trees, houses, and traffic conditions, maintaining a calm and orderly suburban atmosphere.

The vehicle is positioned at an intersection bordered by orange construction barriers on the left and white barriers on the right. The road ahead is marked with "STOP" painted on the asphalt, and a cycle symbol with forward arrows points towards the camera. The background features a multi-story building with large windows, showcasing a mix of architectural styles. A tree with lush green foliage is situated near the center-left of the frame, partially obscuring the view of the construction site. Further back, additional buildings and palm trees are visible under a clear blue sky, indicating a sunny day. As the vehicle moves forward, the "STOP" marking on the road becomes more prominent. The surrounding environment, including the construction barriers, the multi-story building, and the tree, remains static throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the cycle mark on the ground has passed by, and the scene remains unchanged, with the vehicle coming to a stop.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a street intersection in a suburban or urban setting. The scene is framed by a large multi-level building covered with greenery in the background, with trees lining both sides of the road. A "left-turn only" sign is prominently displayed above a red STOP sign. The road features a pedestrian crosswalk marked with white stripes, and the sky is clear with a few scattered clouds. A "ONE WAY" sign with an arrow pointing to the left and a "DO NOT BLOCK" sign are visible in front of the greenery. As the video progresses, a black car enters the frame from the right, driving past the STOP sign and continuing down the road. The car moves smoothly and steadily, remaining within the frame throughout the sequence. In the final frame, the black car is still visible, and its reflection can be seen on the windshield glass of the ego vehicle. The camera maintains a stable viewpoint, capturing the intersection and its surroundings as the vehicle moves forward.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, positioned at an intersection in a suburban residential area. The car's dashboard is visible at the bottom of the video frame, indicating the camera is mounted on the windshield. The road ahead is marked with a "STOP" sign painted directly onto the asphalt, suggesting a mandatory stop for vehicles approaching this point. The surroundings are lush with greenery; trees and bushes line both sides of the street, and a variety of houses can be seen in the background. One house on the left has a white exterior with a dark roof and a garage with a few cars parked on its driveway, while another larger house with a beige facade and a brown chimney is situated further back. The sky above is partly cloudy, allowing patches of blue to peek through, contributing to the serene atmosphere of the neighborhood. As the video progresses, the vehicle continues its journey down the road, approaching an intersection with the red octagonal "STOP" sign situated on the pavement. The ego vehicle maintains a steady pace, and the surrounding environment remains unchanged, with the same houses, trees visible, and a silver pickup truck also approaching the intersection from the opposite direction. Both the ego vehicle and the pickup truck come to a complete stop at the "STOP" sign line, and after briefly pausing, the silver pickup truck proceeds to move forward, continuing down the road by the final frame.

prompt_en: The video opens with a nighttime urban street scene viewed from inside a car, likely through a dashboard camera. The road is wet, reflecting the streetlights and traffic lights, suggesting recent rain. A white truck is driving in the wrong direction, heading towards a red traffic light. On the left side, another vehicle is waiting at the same red traffic light. The surrounding area includes buildings with illuminated windows, indicating residential or commercial use. Streetlights line both sides of the road, casting a yellowish glow over the scene. The crosswalk markings are clearly visible on the road surface. Traffic lights are visible on both sides of the street. As the video progresses, the white truck runs the red light and crashes into the vehicle waiting at the intersection. By the end of the video, the traffic light turns green, and the truck and the other vehicle end up facing each other as a result of the collision. The camera remains stationary throughout, capturing the entire sequence from a fixed position inside the car.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through a wide-angle lens that captures a busy urban intersection under a clear blue sky. The scene is set in a commercial district, with modern buildings featuring large windows and colorful signage. A prominent white multi-story building stands out on the right side, while a more eclectic, multi-colored building with various advertisements is visible on the left. Several cars are parked along the streets, and a few are in motion. A black SUV is standing directly ahead, and a white sedan is moving to its left. The crosswalk is clearly marked with white stripes, and traffic lights are present at the intersection. As the video progresses, the black SUV continues moving forward, crossing the intersection. The traffic light remains green, facilitating the smooth movement of vehicles. The ego vehicle overtakes a stopped SUV ahead which is waiting to make a left turn. The surrounding buildings and parked cars remain static, maintaining their positions as the vehicles navigate the urban environment. By the final frame, the intersection is less crowded, with fewer vehicles in motion, and the scene continues to depict a typical day in a bustling city.

prompt_en: The video begins with a wide-angle view from inside a vehicle, capturing a parking lot scene. The foreground shows part of the dashboard, indicating the camera is mounted within the car. In the center of the exit area of the parking lot, a group of approximately 15 geese gather together, slowly moving from right to left. The area is bordered by trees and shrubs, with a mix of greenery and paved surfaces. Several cars are parked along the road, including a white sedan near the center and a black SUV further back. To the left, there's a yellow road sign. In the background, there are buildings. The sky is overcast, casting a soft light over the entire scene. The ego vehicle is slowly moving forward to wait for the geese to pass. The video captures the serene interaction between the geese and the urban environment, emphasizing the gentle movement of the birds against the backdrop of a typical parking lot setting.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out onto a suburban street under a clear blue sky. The road stretches ahead, bordered by grassy sidewalks and a few scattered trees. On the right side of the street, there's a building with a sign that reads "LUCK OPTICAL," suggesting a business establishment. Several parked cars line the curb near this building. A white SUV is positioned at an intersection, seemingly waiting to turn left. To the left, a white pickup truck is seen driving towards the intersection. As the video progresses, the white SUV at the intersection begins to move forward, turning left into the adjacent street. At that moment, it is slightly hit by the oncoming white pickup. Both vehicles come to a stop in the middle of the intersection due to the collision.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the entire scene, emphasizing the suburban setting and the interaction between the two vehicles. The clear blue sky and the presence of scattered trees add to the serene yet dynamic atmosphere of the video.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a multi-lane road under a partly cloudy sky. The road curves gently to the left, bordered by trees on the right side and a grassy area with some structures visible in the distance. A white sedan is ahead, driving in the same lane as the camera's perspective. Further down the road, a large truck with a colorful advertisement on its side is seen, along with other vehicles including a white SUV. The road markings are visible, and there are signs indicating directions. Three different lane markers, left-turn only, left-or-right turn, and right-turn only, are seen on the road. Corresponding traffic signs are visible on both sides of the road. As the video progresses, the white sedan ahead begins to slow down and then comes to a stop at an intersection marked by a yield sign. The ego vehicle continues forward, maintaining a steady pace behind the stopped sedan. The truck further ahead also slows down slightly but remains in motion. The surrounding environment, including the trees and road signs, remains static throughout the sequence. By the final frame, the ego vehicle has passed the intersection where the white sedan had stopped and reached a point from which green traffic lights at the intersection are visible. The road continues straight ahead, with the truck now further ahead and the white SUV still visible in the lane to the left. The trees and road signs remain unchanged, and the sky retains its partly cloudy appearance.  A steady, forward-moving shot from the perspective of a dashboard camera captures the journey on a multi-lane road, showcasing the dynamic interaction between vehicles and the static beauty of the roadside environment.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a car, looking out onto a residential street under an overcast sky. The scene is framed by two-story houses on both sides of the road. On the left, neutral-toned buildings stand, while on the right, a red-brick house catches the eye. Parked cars line both sides of the street, including sedans, vans, and SUVs. As the video progresses, a white car appears on the left side of the frame with its door open, indicating someone might be exiting. The ego vehicle slows down and cautiously passes the white car. Meanwhile, several vehicles are seen driving by on the right. The camera remains stationary, capturing the everyday activity of the neighborhood from a first-person perspective.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle stopped at a four-way intersection under a clear blue sky. The hood of the car reflects the road ahead, showing a wide, quiet suburban street lined with houses and utility poles. Traffic lights hang above the intersection, all displaying green signals. On the left, a small, single-story house with a light-colored exterior and a brown roof is visible, surrounded by a well-maintained lawn and shrubs. Across the street, another similar house is present, also with a brown roof and light-colored walls. A white SUV is seen driving across the intersection on the opposite lane of the ego vehicle, while a silver sedan waits at the stop line on the far right side of the frame. The road is marked with standard traffic lines, and trees and additional houses are visible in the background, reinforcing the suburban neighborhood setting.  As the video progresses, the ego vehicle performs an unprotected left turn at a green light, yielding to the oncoming white SUV from the opposite lane before completing the left turn, while the silver sedan remains stationary at the stop line. The traffic lights continue to display green, allowing the SUV to proceed smoothly. The surrounding environment, including the houses, trees, and utility poles, remains static, maintaining the tranquil suburban ambiance. By the end of the video, the scene depicts a calm and orderly intersection with minimal activity, emphasizing the peacefulness of the suburban area.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a wide, open road ahead under an overcast sky. The road is marked with white directional arrows indicating left or straight-right turns. Two lines of orange traffic cones are placed along the center of the road, suggesting some form of construction or roadwork. Within the area enclosed by the traffic cones, an arrow board displays flashing arrows pointing left and right to guide traffic around the detour. On either side of the road, there are grassy areas with small trees and shrubs. In the background, modern buildings, possibly part of an urban or suburban area, are visible, with a pedestrian bridge crossing above the road. The overall atmosphere is calm and quiet, with no other vehicles or pedestrians in sight.  As the video progresses, the car changes lanes to the left and continues along the road marked with directional arrows and lined with traffic cones. The camera angle shifts slightly to show the car moving further down the road, passing more traffic cones and approaching the pedestrian bridge, which remains visible above the road. The scene maintains a steady pace, emphasizing the calm and orderly nature of the roadwork and traffic guidance.

prompt_en: The video opens with a nighttime scene captured from the perspective of a dashboard camera inside a vehicle that slowly moves to the center of the intersection, where it yields to the oncoming vehicle while waiting to make a left turn. The road ahead is dimly lit by streetlights, creating a soft glow that reflects off the ego vehicle's hood. Residential houses line both sides of the street, featuring various architectural styles, including a house with a white picket fence on the left side and another with no fence on the right side of the video. A few trees are visible in the background, their silhouettes standing out against the dark sky. A few cars are parked along the curbside, and two vehicles are seen approaching the camera, with one of them passing by the ego vehicle. A signboard with a sign that reads "speed limit 25" can also be seen on the right side of the road across the intersection. The scene remains largely unchanged, maintaining the tranquil suburban atmosphere under the night sky. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the intersection and the approaching traffic.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a tunnel, likely captured from the dashboard camera of a vehicle. The tunnel's interior is illuminated by rows of overhead lights that cast a warm glow across the concrete walls and ceiling. The road ahead is marked with white lane lines, and several vehicles can be seen traveling in the same direction, including two white cars. The tunnel appears to be relatively wide, with a smooth, curved design that gently curves upwards towards the light at the far end. As the video progresses, the white cars move further away. The tunnel's lighting gradually brightens as the vehicle approaches the exit, creating a sense of forward motion and transition from the enclosed space into daylight. By the final frame, the tunnel's interior is bathed in a brighter light, indicating the vehicle has moved closer to the exit, with the white cars now significantly further ahead.

The foreground features the hood of the car, which reflects the surroundings. On the left side of the street, several parked cars, including a red sedan and a dark SUV, are visible. Across the street, a white house with a dark roof and a garage is situated, partially obscured by trees and bushes. A small pink and white trailer is parked near the house, and a person can be seen walking along the sidewalk on the right side of the frame. As the video progresses, the camera remains stationary, capturing the same scene without any noticeable changes in the positions of the objects or the person walking. The person continues their movement, gradually moving further away from the camera's perspective. The pink and white trailer remains stationary, and the parked cars and house stay in their original positions. The scene maintains a tranquil and unchanging environment, with no significant actions or new objects introduced. By the end of the video, the scene remains consistent with the initial frame, depicting a peaceful suburban street with no notable changes.

The intersection is marked with clear road markings that include pedestrian crossings and traffic signals, with the traffic light initially showing red. Surrounding the intersection are trees and a few buildings, including one with a brown roof and beige walls. The hood of the ego vehicle is visible at the bottom of the frame, reflecting the cloudy sky. As the video progresses, the ego vehicle comes to a stop at the intersection, and then it turns right after the traffic light changes from red to green. The scene remains largely unchanged, with no significant movement or new objects appearing, maintaining the same composition and elements throughout the scene. By the final frame, the vehicle has started moving, indicated by the changing traffic light and the slight shift in perspective, suggesting the vehicle is now in motion across the intersection.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a street scene in an urban area under a clear blue sky. The road is lined with trees and various buildings, including a prominent multi-story structure with a light-colored facade and some signage in Chinese characters. To the left, there's a white fence running parallel to the road, separating it from the opposite side of the road. On the right side, there are parked cars and a covered area that appears to be a market or a small shopping complex. As the video progresses, a large sprinkler truck approaches from the opposite side of the road, spraying a wide stream of water across the road. The water creates a mist that partially obscures the view of the vehicles ahead. As the mist gradually settles, the surrounding cars and urban environment become more visible. By the final frame, the water has mostly cleared, revealing a clear view of the street with the vehicles and cityscape remaining consistent throughout the sequence.  A wide-angle shot from inside a vehicle, capturing the urban street scene with a sprinkler truck approaching and spraying water.

prompt_en: A dashcam video captures a multi-lane urban street intersection under clear skies with the sun low on the horizon, casting long shadows. The scene is set in a commercial area, with several cars visible, including a white van directly ahead and others moving in both directions. The road is lined with trees on the right side, providing shade for the sidewalk, where a few parked cars are also visible. Traffic lights hang above the intersection, and in the distance, more buildings and signs can be seen. The overall atmosphere is calm, with no immediate signs of congestion or activity beyond the steady flow of traffic. The ego vehicle, positioned behind the white van, slows down as it approaches the intersection, with the white van's rear right-turn signal flashing. A few other vehicles are stopped in the ego vehicle's lane at red traffic lights. The camera angle provides a first-person perspective from within the ego vehicle, capturing the view through the windshield and hood, emphasizing the calm yet dynamic urban environment.

prompt_en: A point-of-view video shot from inside a vehicle, capturing a quiet suburban street bathed in bright sunlight. The road is lined with parked cars on both sides, and buildings, likely residential or small businesses, are visible across the street. A "STOP" sign is prominently displayed near the center of the intersection. The sky is clear and blue, with the sun shining brightly overhead, casting long shadows on the pavement. On the left side of the street, several vehicles are parked, including a van with some text on its side. Across the street, a white van is parked near two trash bins, and a red SUV is parked further down. The buildings on either side have a mix of architectural styles, with some featuring flat roofs and others with sloped roofs. Overhead, numerous power lines stretch across the street, and a few trees are visible in the background, partially obscuring the view of the buildings. As the video progresses, a white pickup truck makes a turn into the adjacent opposite lane, briefly encroaching into the ego vehicle's lane. The ego vehicle slows down and comes to a stop, waiting until the pickup fully enters the opposite lane before proceeding. The other vehicles remain stationary, parked along the curb. The scene remains static otherwise, with no significant changes in the environment or additional objects entering the frame. By the end of the video, the silver pickup truck has moved out of the camera view, while another white car enters the frame from the left, the rest of the scene remains largely unchanged, maintaining the same composition and lighting conditions as the beginning.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a vehicle, looking out through the windshield onto a suburban street under a bright, clear blue sky. The sun is high in the sky, casting a glare that slightly distorts the edges of the frame. The road is lined with lush green trees on both sides, and a tall, dark-colored fence runs parallel to the street on the right. A utility pole with power lines stretches across the scene, with a length of the wire coiled and hung from the pole. In front of the camera, a silver pickup truck is parked, its rear facing the viewer. A car passes by the ego vehicle, moving in the direction of the ego vehicle's motion. The ego vehicle slowly reverses to create sufficient space between itself and the white pickup in front. The truck remains stationary throughout the sequence, while the leaves of the trees to the right of the truck sway gently throughout the video. The video maintains a consistent perspective without abrupt changes in camera angle, capturing the serene suburban atmosphere under the bright sunlight.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by a dashboard camera, showing a multi-lane urban road during what appears to be early morning or late afternoon, judging by the soft, diffused lighting. The sky is overcast, casting a muted light over the scene. A few vehicles are also seen moving on the other side of the road. On the right side of the road, there's a large brick building with numerous windows, some of which have greenery at their bases. A concrete barrier separates the lanes, and further down the road, modern glass buildings can be seen in the background. A white truck labeled "got milk?" is prominently visible ahead in the same lane as the ego vehicle, but remains stationary throughout the video. Other cars, including a blue sedan directly in front, are also present on the road.  As the video progresses, the rear lights of the stationary white truck labeled "got milk?" become clearly visible and appear prominently as the ego vehicle moves closer. The ego vehicle then makes two consecutive right lane changes, transitioning from the leftmost lane into the rightmost lane, passing by the stationary truck. The blue sedan ahead of the ego vehicle also remains stationary throughout the sequence and does not change lanes. The surrounding environment remains consistent with the large brick building and modern glass structures in the background appearing static. A reflection of the "got milk?" truck is visible on the bonnet and windshield of the ego vehicle during the video.  By the end of the video, the white truck labeled "got milk?" remains stationary in its lane, while the ego vehicle has moved past it and continues down the road. The blue sedan that was initially in front of the ego vehicle remains in its original position in the left lane throughout the video. Additionally, a "right-turn only" lane marker is visible on the surface of the road, and red traffic lights are seen at the end of the video. No vehicles in the video collide with each other at any point. The overall scene remains largely unchanged, with the urban road, the large brick building, and the modern glass structures still visible in the background.

prompt_en: The video opens with a wide-angle shot of a snowy highway during a winter storm. The sky is overcast and gray, with snowflakes continuously falling, creating a hazy and muted atmosphere. The road surface is covered with a layer of snow and slush, reflecting the recent snowfall or melting conditions. Several vehicles are visible, including a sedan stopped near the left of the road and a large semi-truck that has overturned on its side due to accident, blocking part of the lane. Debris from the accident is scattered around the overturned truck, which is tilted at an angle. In the background, additional vehicles can be seen, some appearing to be stuck due to the accident conditions. A person is standing near the sedan, possibly assessing the situation or assisting with the accident. The surrounding area includes patches of grass and low vegetation visible through the snow, suggesting the highway is in a rural or less developed region.  As the video progresses, a large white semi-truck drives onto the overturned truck, kicking up a significant amount of debris in its wake. The truck moves from right to left across the frame, partially obscuring the view of the accident site. By the final frame, the semi-truck has crashed further down the road, leaving behind a trail of disturbed debris. The camera remains stationary throughout, capturing the unfolding chaos and the harsh winter conditions.

prompt_en: A wide-angle shot captures a sunny suburban street intersection, where the bright sunlight casts sharp shadows across the road. The scene is framed by a row of houses with beige and brown roofs, and lush green lawns. Autumn-colored trees add vibrant red and orange hues to the landscape. Overhead power lines stretch across the sky, and a fire hydrant is visible on the right side of the frame near the curb. A silver sedan is parked on the driveway of a house on the left, while a silver SUV is parked on the street in front of the house at the center of the camera view. The ego vehicle waits to turn right at the t-intersection, yielding to two other vehicles traveling in opposite directions. A black car enters the frame from the right, driving across the intersection and continuing straight ahead. The car's movement is smooth and steady, and it exits the frame to the left. The final frame shows the intersection with a vehicle moving from the left to the right side, the silver sedan and the SUV still parked in their initial positions, and the black car having moved out of view.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, looking out through its windshield at a bustling urban street scene. The focal point is a large, ornate red and gold gate archway, adorned with intricate designs and Chinese characters, marking the entrance to what appears to be a Chinatown district. The gate is flanked by modern buildings; on the left, a multi-story office building with large windows, and on the right, storefronts, including a "Food Market" sign. Several cars are parked along both sides of the street, with a mix of sedans and SUVs visible. The street itself is relatively busy with traffic, including a silver SUV that is prominently positioned in the foreground, facing the opposite direction of the ego vehicle.  As the video progresses, the silver SUV begins to move forward on the opposite lane, slowly exiting the frame to the left, revealing more of the street and the surrounding buildings. The sky above is partly cloudy, allowing patches of sunlight to filter through, casting a soft light over the scene. The traffic continues to flow smoothly, with other vehicles, including a blue sedan and a gray minivan, maintaining their positions throughout the video. The scene remains vibrant and dynamic, reflecting the constant activity typical of a busy urban area. A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the bustling street and the iconic gate archway.

prompt_en: The video opens with a view from inside a car, positioned at an intersection in a residential neighborhood during the late afternoon or early evening. The sky is clear, and the lighting suggests a calm, serene atmosphere. The street is lined with parked cars on both sides, including a mix of sedans and SUVs. On the left side of the street, multi-story buildings with large windows and balconies, painted in muted tones like gray and beige, stand tall. Trees with full canopies line the right side of the street, partially obscuring the view of the sidewalk and some parked cars. A woman in a blue dress is seen running across the street from the left side towards the center, heading toward a stationary sedan stopped ahead for a pickup, with its rear hazard lights flashing. The cars on the street remain stationary, indicating that traffic has come to a halt for pedestrians and for the pickup maneuver. As she reaches the sedan, the ego vehicle briefly crosses into the opposite lane to overtake the stationary vehicle. By the final frame, the woman has reached the sedan.  A medium shot from the perspective of the car's dashboard, capturing the intersection and the surrounding environment.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, through the windshield, onto an urban street scene. The car is positioned under a concrete overpass, with the dashboard visible at the bottom of the frame. The road ahead is marked with a "STOP" sign, bike lane markings, and pedestrian crosswalks painted in white stripes. Surrounding the intersection are modern high-rise buildings, including one with a glass facade and another with a red brick exterior. To the left, there's a smaller, low-rise building with a white wall and some greenery. An all-way stop sign stands prominently on the right side of the intersection, with a no-left-turn sign above it, near a sidewalk bordered by large potted plants. The sky above is partly cloudy, suggesting a daytime setting with diffused sunlight.  As the video progresses, the car continues its journey forward, emerging from beneath the overpass and approaching the intersection. The camera remains stationary, capturing the steady movement of the vehicle as it navigates the empty streets. The surrounding environment remains unchanged, with the high-rise buildings, stop sign, and pedestrian crosswalks remaining static throughout the sequence. When the video starts, a black SUV is visible moving towards the right of the frame on the road across the intersection. By the final frame, the ego vehicle has moved closer to the intersection, slowing down, gradually coming to a stop, occluding the painted "STOP" sign, passing the all-way stop sign on the right, and crosswalks are partially visible, with modern buildings continuing to frame the scene, at the t-intersection.

prompt_en: The video begins with a view from inside a vehicle, likely captured by the dashboard camera, showing a suburban street scene bathed in the warm glow of the sun. The sky is clear with a few wispy clouds, and the sun is positioned high, creating a scenario of driving under strong backlighting that casts long shadows across the road. The street is lined with houses featuring various architectural styles, with a few of them having compound walls. A few cars can be seen parked on both sides of the street, including two silver SUVs and a black sedan. A large tree with a dense canopy dominates the video frame, casting its shadow over the road. The ego vehicle slowly approaches an intersection, facing a "STOP" sign situated on the pavement. As the video progresses, the silver SUV begins to drive away from the intersection, moving out of the frame to the left, and several vehicles can be seen parked across the street, beyond the intersection. The STOP sign on the road remains visible as the car approaches the intersection, and the overall scene continues to depict a calm, residential area with minimal activity.  A medium shot from a slightly elevated perspective captures the street and the surrounding environment, emphasizing the long shadows cast by the bright sunlight. The houses, parked cars, and the large tree create a serene suburban atmosphere, with the STOP sign adding a sense of order and direction to the scene.

prompt_en: The video showcases a cozy, well-lit home office, beginning with a refrigerator in the foreground on the left, which reflects faint room details and adds depth. The camera tracks to the right in a wide shot, gradually revealing the room’s layout at eye level. At the center is a sleek wooden desk paired with a tan leather chair with black metal framing, forming a workspace. The desk is neatly arranged with a silver laptop, a mouse, a white mug, a notebook, and a pen. Below, a beige rug adds warmth and texture to the light-colored flooring. To the right, a white wooden shelving unit displays jars, baskets, a picture frame, and potted plants, blending charm with practicality. A smaller wooden rack below is neatly organized, while a TV stand elevates a faint screen. Nearby, a dark wooden door and a pegboard wall-mounted organizer with coiled extension cords highlight the room’s multifunctional nature. A small wooden rack near the door holds a potted plant and storage items, enhancing the homey feeling. On the left, a wooden-framed mirror and a small shelf with plants add greenery and balance. A brown sofa with a light upper part extends toward the curtains, while a tall wooden structure adjacent to the refrigerator comes partially into view. The room’s focal point is the large window at the back, framed by burnt-orange sheer curtains that let in soft natural light. This light is complemented by a circular pendant lamp above the desk, soft lighting strips along the shelves, and a desk lamp near the window, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere that harmonizes with the light-colored walls.

prompt_en: A tilt-down shot captures a modern, minimalist, beige architectural space centered around a serene courtyard. The scene showcases a central courtyard flanked by large windows on the second floor and glass walls on the first floor, allowing glimpses into elegantly furnished rooms. Spherical hanging pendant lights are visible through the sliding glass windows with wooden paneling on the second floor, as well as on the room straight ahead and a room on the right side of the frame on the ground floor. Lush greenery is strategically placed throughout the courtyard, with manicured trees and plants creating a natural yet curated atmosphere.  Two prominent trees stand on either side of the frame, their branches reaching towards the ceiling, while additional trees are visible inside the house. A narrow stone walkway, horizontally positioned, leads to a large, open dining area visible through tall glass doors. The dining space is part of an indoor area characterized by sophisticated furnishings, including a long beige dining table surrounded by modern white chairs with beige legs. Floor-to-ceiling windows ensure the indoor and outdoor areas blend seamlessly, allowing the outside to be visible. The outside is foggy, with trees slightly visible in the background. The ground is landscaped with small pebbles surrounding the reflection pools that flank the central walkway. These pools contain smooth, organically shaped rocks, enhancing the serene and natural aesthetic of the courtyard.  The room to the right of the frame also features a table, some chairs, and two objects on top of the table, one orange and the other red. The entire scene is shot in a straight tilt-down without cuts, capturing the symmetry of the beige design elements. Soft lighting illuminates the space, and the outdoor view reveals that it is daytime.

prompt_en: A man in a light gray suit walks through a well-organized hobby shop filled with a variety of toy model kits. The camera follows him from behind with a medium shot at eye level, capturing the neatly arranged shelves on either side. These shelves hold an assortment of vehicle model kits, with some display figures showcasing the finished products. Two propeller biplanes hang directly overhead, one red and one white. At the end of the aisle, a wall display features assembled models of ships and tanks. The shop is softly lit by artificial lighting, creating a cozy and somewhat vintage ambiance due to the densely packed shelves.  As the man reaches the end of the aisle, he turns left and continues walking through the store. To his right is a checkout counter with a computer and cash register. Another man, wearing a black jacket with a distinctive white stripe, a dark-colored watch on his left wrist, and a black glove on his left hand, enters the frame from the right. He is working on stocking and organizing the toy units. The camera then pans to the right with a medium shot at eye level, capturing both individuals in the shot. The man in the gray suit speaks, and the man in the black jacket turns to face him, revealing a white shirt underneath, while picking up a clipboard with his right hand. The clip concludes as he replies to the man in the gray suit but before he can look up and make eye contact.  The background features a row of floor-to-ceiling windows on the left side, letting in a large amount of light from outside. The center and right-hand sides of the background showcase multiple shelves of completed tank models, with a large flat-screen television displaying a video of people playing with remote-controlled tanks.

The dog's long, floppy ears hang down along the sides of its head, initially turned to the left. As the bubbles drift away, the dog turns its head to face forward, shaking its ears slightly. It remains seated on its belly, its stomach moving rhythmically with its breathing. The camera captures a medium shot, showing most of the dog's body but not its full forelegs. The angle is slightly high, maintaining eye level with the dog, and includes random, jittery movements that add a dynamic feel to the scene. The background is softly blurred, with the trunks of trees visible in the distance. Beyond the trees, the ground is brightly lit, but closer to the dog, the grass is interspersed with patches of brown dirt, and the lighting creates a mix of sunlit and shaded areas. The depth-of-field effect keeps the focus sharply on the dog, while the background remains out of focus.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a young child adjusting headphones on their head, set against a backdrop of other children engaged in various activities. The child, with short, straight black hair, holds the headphones using both hands, one on each speaker. The left speaker is secured with a pencil, with the thumb resting on the back of the speaker. The headphones feature a matte, metallic silver finish, with a black plastic headband and a yellow sticker with a barcode near the attachment point. The child's expression shifts from focused to a wide smile, followed by raised eyebrows and puckered lips, as they gaze towards the camera. To the right, a girl with straight black hair and a pink cap looks downward, while another boy turns his head to the side, revealing only his right ear. The background is softly blurred, showcasing greenery and the casual attire of the children, suggesting an outdoor setting. The scene is bathed in natural, diffused light, creating a candid and lively atmosphere.

prompt_en: The video showcases a modern building complex captured from an aerial perspective in a wide, high-angle shot that pans across the structure. The right portion of the building is rectangular and vertically oriented, with a brown facade featuring two large, rectangular windows on either side, both folding inward. Below these windows is a large, central window that also folds inward. Adjacent to this section is a structure made of black-framed glass panels, topped with a light-green material that extends to the neighboring building to its left. The roof of this building hosts two large, white, rectangular objects facing each other, which fold outward to connect with another rectangular structure elevated from the ground, casting a shadow below.  The left side of the building is divided into two parts, forming a corner in the middle, with square protrusions on each half. The roof is white, with a small building on its right corner. Surrounding the building is a snowy landscape, with three leafless trees on the snow-covered ground to the right and more snow-covered patches further along. In front of the building, a paved street is bordered by snow, leading to another paved street with three large, snow-covered patches on its left and leafless trees on soil on its right. The urban backdrop includes buildings, cars, and scattered trees, all bathed in natural daylight. The video is sped up, capturing the rapid movement of people walking in front of the building, adding a dynamic element to the serene winter scene.

prompt_en: The video opens with a fisheye lens perspective, capturing an outdoor street corner where a person is shooting a video focused on a poster. The scene is set on a sunny day with vivid natural lighting, casting shadows across the environment. To the right, a cement sidewalk runs alongside metal scaffolding and canvas fabric covering the surface of a building. On the left, a textured brick wall is visible, adorned with a lighting fixture at the top and a metal mailbox fixed to it, bearing a red sign with white lettering. In the center, an entrance is framed by two doors with black horizontal lines and a jack arch above them.  As the camera pushes in at eye level, it focuses on a poster attached to the building on the right with zip ties. The poster features a man with short black hair, smiling, wearing a white shirt, black jacket, and dark tie. Below his image, white Japanese characters and a blue stripe display the text "まえばら" (Maebara) and "城司" (Shigeki). Behind him, a red streak reads "All for All." The person behind the camera, wearing a silver-rimmed digital watch with a blue band, points at the poster. The camera then pulls back, revealing the person gesturing with an open palm, sliding the poster flat onto the air, and drawing their hand back. The camera suddenly shifts perspective, moving farther back, and the person's left hand comes out, palm facing upwards, making circular motions. The image shakes as the camera pushes in towards the poster and then halts, continuing to shake. Finally, the same hand appears, pointing with the index finger near the poster.  The background includes muted-colored buildings with white, gray, and brown tones, surrounded by wires attached to both the houses and electricity poles. In the distance, people can be seen walking along the street under a clear blue sky.

prompt_en: A man records himself talking as he walks down an urban street, capturing a medium shot from a low angle with random camera movements. He is dressed in a white-collar polo shirt with large dark blue and green horizontal stripes and thin white and red stripes. He has short hair, wears wire-framed glasses, and carries a clip-on microphone on his chest. Blue straps are visible around his shoulders, and he holds a cup with a straw in his left hand. His right arm extends out the bottom left of the frame, holding the camera. Initially, he walks with his head down, but in the middle ground to his right, another man in jeans and a beige jacket walks toward the camera alongside a child. Simultaneously, a white-haired man dressed in black stands on a yellow bike, facing the man and the child. The main figure raises his head momentarily, looking straight ahead, then lowers it again. He then turns his head to the right, lifting his gaze upward and slightly to the left. Throughout the sequence, he speaks continuously while walking. The background is slightly out of focus, with parked cars in the middle ground and a blue parking sign near a booth with a gray roof. Beyond the cars, tall buildings rise against a bright, whitish sky, including a four-story building extending to the right until trees block it from view. Toward the end, a loading cart, a gray pickup truck, a red sign with yellow letters, and an aquamarine bike appear on the right. A person in a red sweater with short white hair enters from the right, walking away from the camera.

prompt_en: A young woman with braided hair, wearing a light blue dress with brown shoulder straps over a white blouse, approaches a wooden door in a narrow hallway. The hallway features a red-painted staircase railing on the left and white walls with a cable duct running vertically. The door, a dark brown panel with a brass lock and handle, is situated on the left side of the scene. Two transparent frames with brown contents are visible at the top right. The woman holds a transparent plastic container with toilet paper and a white plastic bag in her right hand. She places the plastic bag down and then rests the container on a bright pink suitcase to free her hands. She then reaches for a small blue purse at her side, which is a rectangular shape with a metal strap adorned with bright decorations. The camera follows her movements closely, shifting to a medium shot at eye level as she approaches the door. The woman inserts a set of keys into the keyhole, and the camera captures the action from a slightly low-angle perspective, emphasizing her focused expression and the details of her attire and surroundings. The lighting is clear, casting shadows on the wall to the right.

prompt_en: The video captures an aerial view of a train journeying across a long, elevated bridge spanning a calm body of water. The train, consisting of several connected passenger carriages painted in white with a blue wavy design on the lower half and dark windows, travels steadily along the bridge. Its blue and red front adds a vibrant contrast against the muted backdrop. The bridge is supported by sturdy concrete pillars, each equipped with metal railings, a small platform, and a singular black sensor. The vertical support structures along the tracks are evenly spaced.  In the background, a second bridge is visible, currently occupied by two white vans, with a road rather than tracks. Two boats can be seen on the water, their trails fading into the distance as the camera pans left. The scene is set under a vast, slightly overcast sky that casts a warm, hazy light over everything. In the far distance, a cityscape with white buildings stands out against the darker landmass, barely visible through the haze. The camera maintains a high-angle, long shot throughout, panning right to follow the train's movement. The lighting is diffused, with sunlight streaming in from behind the camera to the left, casting subtle shadows on the water and bridge supports.

prompt_en: A woman is seated indoors on a chair with a brown frame and a green backrest, holding white pieces of paper in her hands. She gazes down at the papers with a sad expression, blinking 13 times throughout the sequence. The camera steadily pushes in, focusing on her face and capturing a medium shot at eye level. The woman is wearing makeup, including pale red lipstick and eyeshadow, and is dressed in a white top with a simple design. She accessorizes with large, gold, metallic, puffed, heart-shaped earrings. Her long brown hair is parted in the middle and falls in soft waves over her shoulders. The scene is set during the day, with natural light filtering through a window in the background, featuring sheer curtains and a gold-colored curtain draped over it. To the left of the woman, there is a yellow transparent vase on a horizontal surface, containing tall flower cuttings. To the right, a white cylindrical pillar stands next to the wall, with a metallic object with black lines visible behind it. A wooden rectangle divides the blue wall in the background. The logo in the upper left-hand corner of the frame features a round blue sphere partially enveloped by a silver crescent-like shape.

prompt_en: The video opens with a sweeping aerial view of a dense cluster of high-rise buildings, primarily beige in color, arranged in a tight formation. At the center, a distinctive building with a domed rooftop stands out, surrounded by lush greenery that forms a natural border. Adjacent to this area, smaller pink high-rises add a contrasting hue to the urban landscape. Beyond the immediate high-rise complex, a sprawling cityscape unfolds, with patches of green fields interspersed among the urban skyline. A dark slate-gray river flows through the foreground, bordered by grassy banks and dense vegetation. Train tracks run parallel to the river, with a small train station visible nearby. The camera pans right, revealing a major highway curving through the city, with an overpass spanning the river. As the camera arcs further, it focuses on a set of dark high-rise buildings, framed by smaller high-rises and dark green vegetation in the distance. The scene is bathed in natural light, with white clouds reflected in the river, creating a serene yet dynamic urban tableau.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a man speaking animatedly to the camera in a rustic kitchen setting. The camera moves randomly, focusing on the man who is gesturing with his hands raised, emphasizing points as he speaks. He leans forward, then straightens up, making head movements and continuing to gesture with his right hand while lowering his left hand to pick up a dark bottle with a blue label and cap. The bottle is held at face level towards the end of the clip. The man is wearing a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, unfastened buttons near the neck, and a small black microphone clipped to his shirt. He has short brown hair, a trimmed brown beard, and a partially visible tattoo on his right hand along with a gold ring on his left ring finger.  The kitchen features wooden countertops with various jars, a silver sink, and a bowl of fruits. A green plant and a white cake stand with a brown object are visible nearby. A black kettle sits on the top right of the sink, alongside jars with brown cartoon designs and light strings. A red refrigerator in the background is adorned with stickers and dim lights, with bottles and a dark apron hanging from a plank. The walls are a mix of brown and white, with a space in between and a light bulb illuminating the scene. To the right, there are shelves filled with items, a brown frame, and strings of light hanging. A black coat rack with blue and white fabrics is present, along with a doorway on the far right. The top wall has a gray pattern with brown planks and purple objects attached.

prompt_en: The video showcases two adjacent house entrances, each with distinct architectural details. On the left, a black door with a decorative wreath of green foliage stands out against the dark backdrop. The door is framed by clean white trim with intricate molding, and two lush green potted plants flank the entrance. Above the door, a transom window numbered 29 reflects trees, including one with lights. The building is constructed of beige stone arranged in a uniform pattern. Black wrought iron railings separate the pathways leading up to the entrances.  To the right, a light blue door numbered 28 is similarly framed in white trim with a transom window featuring elegant designs. This door also has a wreath, smaller and with grey and purple hues, hanging on it. The light blue door has a brass mail slot on its bottom left and a door knocker on the other side. A star decoration hangs in the large glass window to the right of this entrance, which also reflects trees. The concrete floor in front of both entrances is wet, adding a reflective quality to the scene.  The camera, positioned at eye level, captures a full shot of the two entrances before slowly pushing in to highlight the intricate details of the doors and their surroundings. The black door has a brass mail slot in its middle and a golden door handle on its left side, while the light blue door has a brass mail slot on its bottom left and a door knocker on the other side. The video is well-lit and conveys a calm, serene atmosphere.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures two men interacting outdoors under a green mesh canopy supported by bamboo poles. The man on the left, wearing a white polo shirt with a pocket on the right chest, has thin rectangular glasses, short hair parted on the right side, a mustache, and a short white beard. He is slightly facing the right, engaging in conversation with the other man. As the scene progresses, he turns his head slightly downwards, placing his hands on his waist, then looks to the left, off-camera, and shifts his body to the right before facing forward again.  The man on the right, sporting black hair parted at the center and rectangular-framed glasses with thin black rims, is dressed in a long-sleeved light pink shirt with black stripes and a pocket on the right chest. His sleeves are rolled up to his elbows. Initially, he is facing forward with his head turned to the left, speaking animatedly with his hands stretched out in front of him. He then closes his mouth, clasps his hands near his chest, and opens his mouth with a slight smile while shifting to his left and facing the other man. He then moves to his right. Both men wear black microphones clipped to their shirts, and the scene is well-lit with natural sunlight. The background features dense greenery, including palm trees and smaller plants, with an open framework of piped natural material and an irregular green mesh fabric overhead. At the bottom, there is a white stand with potted plants and a black nylon bag.

prompt_en: A middle-aged woman is captured in a low-angle, medium shot, pouring a liquid from a large metallic pot into a smaller metallic pail. The scene is dynamic, with random camera movements adding a sense of immediacy. The woman, dressed in a short-sleeved, bright blue T-shirt, is adorned with a colorful fabric wrapped around her body. This fabric is predominantly bright orange with a yellow leaf pattern, and a segment of a black and yellow geometric design is visible near her hips. She wears gold, white, silver, and brown bangles on both wrists, along with an oval, coral ring on her left ring finger. Her black, partially gray hair is tied back, and she has a pink dot on her forehead and a round, yellow earring in her left ear. She is bent forward, gripping the large, metallic pot with both hands, which balances on a rustic, terracotta surface. Using pink fabrics, she carefully holds the pot's mouth as she tilts it slowly downward, pouring a transparent liquid into the smaller metallic pail positioned below. Steam rises from the pot as she follows the motion with her eyes and moves her lips, indicating concentration. She then crouches, resting her left arm on her left knee while continuing to pour the fluid. The background reveals an earthy-toned space with a thatched roof supported by logs. The wall behind her is divided into two sections: a light yellowish-brown upper part and a darker lower section. Various fabrics in shades of orange, yellow, pink, blue, and white hang from the roof, and a green and white object is visible near the left edge of the screen. Soft, bright, ambient lighting illuminates the scene, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere.

prompt_en: A sweeping aerial documentary showcases a striking stone monument of a soldier wearing a helmet, his right arm raised in a commanding pose. The monument is set against the backdrop of a modern cityscape nestled within rolling green hills. It stands adjacent to a circular structure adorned with colorful murals and paintings depicting figures engaged in various activities. On the exterior of the structure, there is a depiction of a man’s face with a star positioned to its left. At the beginning of the scene, individuals are visible near the structure, one wearing white pants and a pink top. Enhancing the urban backdrop, distant mountains under a clear blue sky contribute to the serene ambiance. The city below features a mix of buildings, ranging from modern high-rises to modest structures painted in vibrant colors like red, blue, and white, creating a striking contrast. Roads wind through the city, lined with greenery, connecting various parts of the urban landscape, with a few cars visible traveling along them. At the start of the scene, the camera executes a pedestal-up movement from a high angle to reveal the monument and its surroundings. As the camera pushes out, an additional visitor to the structure comes into view: a person in the center wearing a white shirt and a hat. At this point, symbols become visible near the man’s face previously mentioned—one shaped like a star and the other like a hexagon, positioned to its right. The natural light indicates daytime. Throughout the recording, the camera maintains a smooth, fluid motion and captures the scene with a wide-shot, providing a comprehensive perspective of the scenic and urban landscape.

prompt_en: A man is driving a vehicle while talking to the camera. He is seated in the driver's seat, with the seatbelt on, wearing a light blue polo shirt. He has short, light brown hair, a short beard, and blue eyes. A small mic is attached to his polo shirt. As the shot begins, the subject gestures with his hands while speaking, his demeanor animated and engaging, as the vehicle wobbles slightly. Later, he raises three fingers before a cut moves on to the next shot in which he continues talking while intermittently looking at the road and the camera. On the passenger seat, there are two teddy bears, a large one and a small one, dressed in childlike clothing, including hats and baseball jerseys. The larger teddy wears a blue cap and a red jersey, while the smaller one has a light blue cap and a blue jersey. These bears are positioned upright in the passenger seat. The man's expression shifts from focused to cheerful as he interacts with the camera. The vehicle is moving, as indicated by the changing scenery outside the window, which shows a lush green countryside with fields and distant buildings. The road alongside appears slightly elevated. Inside the cabin, curtains are drawn, and a table and a window can be seen in the background. The shot remains stationary but unsteady, providing a medium shot from eye-level that includes both the main subject and the bears. The lighting is natural, diffused due to an overcast sky.

prompt_en: A woman is seen from behind walking down a picturesque cobblestone street flanked by historic buildings. The scene opens with a low-angle, wide shot, set up at the entrance of a narrow alley. The alleyway extends with a narrow stone path between traditional buildings, showcasing a mix of textures, including smooth stone and rough brick. On the right, a window with dark brown rails on the ground floor reflects the opposite side, accompanied by a narrow, dark brown door with a golden knob and a silver handle, along with a letterbox on its right. Further up, there are other doors and windows on different floors, revealing the intricate architectural details of the buildings.  Close to the camera on the left, a vertically aligned black pipe with some posters stuck to it stands out, alongside a distribution of different small pipes behind the main pipe. As the camera tilts up, the woman is seen from behind, walking steadily down the street. She is wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, a colorful long skirt with geometric patterns in red and blue, and a black backpack. The street is devoid of vehicles, allowing her to stroll unobstructed towards the end of the alley.  The sun casts bright light onto the building at the end of the alley, highlighting its intricate architectural details, including multiple spires and ornate facades. The building is predominantly off-white with a square base and grey-colored roofs, featuring a lantern tower at the center. Flags are seen waving in the breeze atop the building in the background, and other pedestrians are walking in the distance. As she approaches the end of the street, the camera centers on the towering spire of the building, with the lighting adjusted to focus on the details of the structure.

prompt_en: A wide shot captures the elegant interior of a luxurious hallway, showcasing a centered passageway adorned with a richly patterned carpet in deep purple-blue hues, accented with swirls of pink, white-silver, and peach. The camera shakily pushes in, revealing four curved, shiny, ornate wooden counters on the left, each with a cream-colored countertop supporting a silver-colored candelabra and two lamps on either side of a vertically extending rod with a rectangular, black object at the top. Small, black, four-sided devices are visible on most of the desks, with the tops of two other apparatuses partially visible behind them. The fronts of these desks are adorned with swirling, gold patterns, mirroring the designs on the carpet, with gold trim at the bottom. Large, round windows on the left allow bright, natural light to flood the space.  On the right side of the corridor, a curved, clear railing with intricate, swirling designs overlooks an area below. Two round, white columns stand prominently on the right, and the light-colored ceiling is embellished with the same ornate pattern, featuring two luminous, small, green signs hanging from it. Toward the end of the video, a male figure, slightly balding and dressed in a white shirt, dark bottoms, and a blue face mask, stands behind the fourth desktop. He briefly glances up at the camera as it advances, then lowers his head. A fifth counter, similar to the others but much lower, comes into view, with two brown chairs positioned in front of it and a vase with light-blue flowers resting on top. Gentle, recessed artificial lighting, along with a chandelier and additional light fixtures against the walls behind the desks, bathes the hallway in a warm and inviting glow.
