prompt_en: A medium shot captures a man interacting with a small brown puppy in a well-lit room. The man, dressed in a black sweater with yellow patterns around the shoulders and blue jeans, is crouched on the floor, gently holding an infant monkey in his right hand. He extends his left hand towards the playful brown puppy, which stands on its hind legs, reaching out with its front paws. The camera pans right, following the dog as it hops into a dome-shaped tent with a gray lining at the base and floor. Inside the tent, a pink and orange chequered blanket is visible. The man continues to engage with the dog using the same hand, while the puppy alternates between standing on its hind legs and all four legs. The scene is bright and well-lit, with beige tiled flooring and a solid brown object in the foreground. To the left, a white and yellow ride-on toy vehicle with black accents is parked near the tent. Behind the man, a lush decorative plant with red flowers climbs up the wall, and additional greenery, including a white cylindrical pot with multiple plastic plants, a brown rack with horizontal slats, and a small brown surface with one of its short legs, appears on the right. The video ends with a slight pan to the left, showing the dog jumping away to the right.

prompt_en: The video captures an old man cooking in a cozy kitchen while carrying a child. The medium shot is taken at eye level, showcasing the man's focused yet gentle demeanor. He has short, gray hair and wears square, transparent glasses in a black frame. His black apron, adorned with red-colored letter designs, contrasts with his dark-colored t-shirt underneath. The man holds the child securely with his left hand, while his right hand skillfully stirs a semi-liquid mixture of white and green ingredients in a shiny silver pan on the black stove.  The child, dressed in red pants and a white full-sleeved t-shirt, curiously observes the cooking process. They both turn to their left as the man speaks, adding a dynamic element to the scene. The child's attention is captivated by the stirring action, and they hold onto the shiny silver chain on the man's neck with their left hand. The man picks up some white food with a wooden spatula and brings it to his mouth, while the child watches intently.  The kitchen setting is warm and inviting, with a black countertop in the foreground. On the counter, there's a wooden cutting board with a knife and white pieces of food, a wine glass filled with yellow liquid, and a red bowl. Another similar pan is visible on the stove to the left. Behind the man, a large beige wooden cabinet houses a black baking oven and a shiny, dark-grey side-by-side refrigerator. The fridge is decorated with numerous pictures, and a gray cloth hangs on the shiny handle. Above the refrigerator, books and a small plant add a personal touch to the space. The gray wall on the left features four black frames, completing the homely atmosphere.

prompt_en: An outdoor sports video captures a cyclist performing a high jump on a rugged mountain trail. The cyclist, riding a dark bicycle and wearing black pants, a black and orange shirt, and a white helmet, executes a daring maneuver. The camera, using a fish-eye lens and panning to the right at a low angle, follows the cyclist as they soar through the air with the bike turned on its side. The cyclist maintains an almost horizontal position, their shadow boldly cast on the beige, rocky ground below. They leap over a small wooden wall made of gray logs and a short incline in the dirt road, with the camera continuing to pan with them. A light brown poster advertisement is embedded in the incline before the lip of the hill. As the cyclist turns their body and the bike, they land on the road wheels first, creating a cloud of dust. The camera transitions to an eye-level shot, focusing on the rider as they continue down the path. A drone flies across the top of the frame, changing direction to the right, while the camera remains focused on the cyclist with slight random movements. Before the cyclist is out of sight, they fall to their left, and the bike flips to the right. The camera quickly zooms in.  The scene is set against a backdrop of lush, green but rocky terrain with rolling hills and valleys. A dirt path cuts through a dense forest of trees leading to a ramp made of wooden slats. A rocky, grassy hill forms the background, dotted with small trees and spectators standing along the trail. Many spectators hold devices in their hands, capturing the event. In the foreground, a person with a camera stands hunched over, wearing a sandy hat and a black tank top. The sky is a deep blue with scattered clouds, adding to the scenic beauty of the setting.

prompt_en: In a softly lit room with a pale beige wall, a woman stands in front of a mirror, performing a meticulous cleansing routine. The camera captures the scene in an over-the-shoulder shot at eye level, subtly moving to keep the focus on her actions and interactions with the mirror. Positioned slightly to the left of the frame, the woman’s reflection is visible in the mirror to the right. Her long, dark brown hair is neatly styled and cascades over her shoulders. She is dressed in a black lace-patterned top layered under a dark cloak-like garment with a blue trim, and a white lanyard hangs around her neck.  The woman begins by talking while looking down and picking up a tissue in her left hand to wipe the left side of her face near the temple, glancing into the mirror. She continues speaking as she inspects the tissue, then switches it to her right hand to wipe the right side of her face and her chin. Her movements are deliberate and methodical, and she pauses briefly to examine the tissue after each action. Next, she wipes her lips in a quick motion while speaking, picks up a new tissue, and wipes her lips again a few times, inspecting it closely. Throughout the sequence, her expression remains focused and calm, with periodic glances at herself in the mirror as she continues her routine. The background is softly lit, creating a neutral and slightly warm ambiance.

prompt_en: A man with short, brown, curly hair and a small patch of gray in front of his right ear, a brown beard, and a black long-sleeve jacket explores a scenic coastal forest trail. He carries a black backpack and holds a black camera with a large lens in his left hand. The man walks along a light sandy path, facing the right side of the screen as he moves in that direction. The camera tracks him, capturing his right profile and partially from the back. As he walks, he tilts his head slightly to the left, then angles it further left and upward. His gaze lowers again as he continues. The path beneath him is a light sandy color, bordered by brown and green grass that sways gently in the breeze. In the middle ground, a few branches and a large rock lie across the way. Tall, slender trees with foliage only at the very tops stretch from left to right, many of their trunks leaning towards the left of the frame. The forest floor is a mix of soil and low-lying grass, with scattered undergrowth adding texture to the landscape.  In the background, extending from left to right, the gray ocean can be seen, with giant boulders poking out of the water not far from the shore. The boulder is visible towards the center of the frame as the camera pans right, revealing more gnarled trees along the edge of the beach. Some pieces of driftwood appear towards the right side of the frame. The sky above the water is cloudy and gray, creating a hazy atmosphere. The scene is captured at eye level with a medium shot throughout, emphasizing the natural beauty of the coastal forest trail and the serene ocean beyond.

prompt_en: A wide shot captures a boat deck on a narrow body of water, facing a metal lock gate surrounded by stone walls of a canal. The water is in constant motion, creating white foam as it flows towards the boat. The stone walls are dark, with patches of grass growing out of them. The ground is covered with green grass, and trees of various shapes line both sides of the canal. The sky is cloudy, casting natural light over the scene.  The boat's deck is white, adorned with a cross-shaped structure and two flags: the French tricolor flag and another flag with a white background, featuring a red circle and a blue swallow-tail shape. On the left side of the frame, an elderly woman in a purple top, sunglasses, a red scarf, and dark gray pants stands near the mooring post, holding the rope attached to the boat. Stone stairs with metal railings lead up to the lock gate, which is divided into two flanks. On top of the lock gate, a person is standing on the right flank, while another slowly moves forward on the left flank. A white car is parked next to a green tree beside the stairs, with a short green fence separating it from the vehicle. Behind the car, a house with beige walls and a tiled roof is visible. The entire scene is captured in a wide shot with random camera movements at eye level.

prompt_en: In this video, a bearded man wearing a light gray long-sleeved zip-up hoodie is seen in a compact, well-organized kitchen cutting a piece of fruit with a knife. The man, positioned in an eye-level medium shot, holds a silver knife with a white handle in his right hand and half of a sliced fruit in his left hand. The kitchen features a small gimbaled silver stovetop with two burners, above which there's a microwave set within a built-in cabinet. The stovetop, which rocks slightly throughout the video, has a skillet over the right burner. The scene starts with the man turning to his right and then back towards the camera, with the camera making small random motions. As the camera moves, the man begins to talk, facing the camera, and proceeds to slice the fruit. He then places the knife on the countertop towards his right and offers the sliced fruit to the person behind the camera. The person, wearing a full-sleeved black top, extends their left hand to take the slice of the fruit. The kitchen is well-lit with natural light coming from two small windows adjacent to the area. Part of a metal handle can be seen in front of the person by the window to the left. In the background, a hanging basket with various colored fruits is visible on the countertop. A step-up stool is partly visible next to the black and white countertop towards the right side, and some small potted plants are also present on the countertop below the window on the right side. The overall setting suggests a cozy, functional kitchen space, likely aboard a boat given the compact design and the presence of a skylight.

The black ceramic handle of an object is visible to the right of the broccoli. The camera captures this arrangement from a high angle, panning right across the long line of containers. Each metal container is nested within another, resting on a white table. Reflected in the cellophane, the bulbs above create two round spheres of light across the broccoli. The camera tilts up slightly towards the end before coming to a stop.

prompt_en: A person is captured walking through a vast and expansive desert landscape, filmed from a low-angle tracking shot that follows their steady ascent up a large, gently sloping sand dune. The individual, seen from behind, wears a striped gray hoodie with the hood up and dark blue denim shorts, complemented by blue sports shoes with white socks. They carry a water bottle in their left hand, and only part of their right arm from the elbow up is visible. The heavy wind ripples their clothing as they walk, emphasizing the dynamic movement against the serene backdrop. The walking pace is unhurried yet determined, highlighting the vastness and tranquility of the desert setting. The camera maintains focus on the subject, slightly shifting to the right to reveal a distant mountain in the background. As the individual ascends the slope, the camera tilts up slightly, capturing the upward motion. The sand dunes dominate the scenery, stretching out endlessly with gentle slopes and a slightly rippled texture. Sparse vegetation is visible on some dune slopes on the right, adding subtle detail to the otherwise barren landscape. The diffused white lighting from the overcast sky enhances the sense of depth and scale, creating a peaceful yet adventurous atmosphere.

prompt_en: In this video, a man and a woman are hiking up a hill amidst a rugged mountain landscape. The woman stands out in a vibrant hot pink jacket with black zippers and the Norwegian flag embroidered on the right side and on her right sleeve. She pairs it with a matching pink beanie featuring the inscription “GETOUT” in pink against a white rectangular background. She is wearing black-framed glasses and a backpack with black straps. Beside her on the right is the man, dressed in a black jacket with orange zippers and the Norwegian flag embroidered on the right chest. He complements his outfit with a plain black beanie, a dark blue shirt beneath his jacket, and a gray saddle bag slung across his body from his left shoulder. Both hikers exude a cheerful demeanor, smiling expressively as they gesture animatedly toward the camera.  The woman waves energetically with her left hand before raising both hands in a playful thumbs-up gesture, shaking them back and forth. The man mirrors her enthusiasm, giving a thumbs-up with his left hand as he smiles warmly. They walk side by side along the rocky path, glancing alternately at the camera and the trail ahead. The setting is serene, with thick clouds hanging low over jagged peaks in the distance. Green and brown grasses cover the rolling hills, appearing slightly damp. Despite the cloudy skies, the ambient lighting is soft and even, illuminating the hikers and the landscape. The camera maintains a medium shot at eye level, tracking backward with slight bounces to capture the hikers’ steady pace up the narrow, rocky path.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a woman in a vibrant yellow sari with embroidered details and a deep red blouse with frilled shoulders, preparing food in a warmly lit kitchen. Her hair is neatly pulled back and styled with a large yellow fabric piece matching the sari. She wears a white bracelet on her left wrist, a darker bracelet on her right, gold earrings, and a necklace. The left side of the room is dimly lit, with a basket of food hanging from the ceiling and a wooden object below it. A shiny pot and a pitcher sit on a table beneath the basket. The woman, facing the right side of the room, picks up a food item with her left hand and scoops up another ingredient with her right. The camera follows the second ingredient, moving slightly down before returning to focus on the woman as she kneads it rhythmically with her right hand. She then places the ingredient inside the food item in her left hand and gently folds the edges. Her focused expression underscores her concentration on the task. The background features a white vase with colorful flowers, a basket of food, a brown rectangular vessel, and a black lantern casting a gentle glow, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The scene is filmed at eye level, capturing the intricate details of her movements and the cozy kitchen setting.

prompt_en: A modern, open-concept living space is showcased in a smooth, gradual tilt-up camera motion, shot at a high angle and framed in a long shot. The lower portion of the living room features a gray sofa on the left, with a rectangular table in front of it adorned with a teapot, cups, and a plate of cookies on a woven tray. This arrangement rests on a large beige and golden brown-patterned rug atop a brown tiled floor. To the right, part of a sleek black leather chair with a patterned cushion is visible, along with a recessed black speaker. Above the speaker, a flat-screen television is mounted on the wall.  The camera angle shifts to eye level, revealing a staircase on the left with dark wooden steps, a white base, and a black metal railing leading to the upper level. Adjacent to the staircase, a rectangular artwork with yellow and black motifs hangs on the white wall. The open kitchen area is then revealed, showcasing a black island countertop with a glossy white base. Two white bar stools with chrome bases are tucked beneath the counter, which is topped with a vibrant green fruit bowl and other items. Above the counter, three pendant lights with bronze shades cast a warm glow.  The camera transitions to a low-angle and medium shot, capturing the double-height ceiling and upper-level features. A glass balustrade lines the upper floor, offering a view of a second artwork with earthy tones. A large abstract painting with black brushstrokes and red accents is mounted on the upper wall. A modern chandelier with irregular metallic rings and exposed bulbs hangs prominently. Greenery is visible through a tall upper-level window.  Throughout the clip, a logo in the top-right corner features two vertical rectangles, yellow on the left and blue on the right, outlined in white. The lighting combines natural daylight streaming through the window with warm illumination from the pendant lights and chandelier, also reflected on the glass balustrade, creating a bright yet cozy atmosphere.

prompt_en: A close-up shot captures a person in a white apron over a shirt with small white and blue square patterns, holding a plate with a yellow rim and a beige center. The individual uses a spoon in their right hand to interact with the food, which appears to be a mixture of yellowish and whitish chunks, possibly mashed or shredded. The person's left hand, gripping the plate, moves slightly, touching the spoon to the food. The background transitions from a turquoise area with dark patterns to a mustard-colored section on the right. The scene is brightly lit, with reflections visible on the plate's yellow section. The person's movements are subtle, involving back-and-forth plate motions and spoon interactions. The camera maintains a static, eye-level angle throughout the video.

prompt_en: A close-up of a man in a stained shirt taking a drink of liquid from a clear bottle, set against a backdrop of dense green foliage, suggesting a jungle or forest environment. The natural light filters through the leaves, casting a warm glow on the man’s face and highlighting the moisture on his skin. The man, with disheveled, wavy dark brown hair that falls over his forehead and ears, has a short dark beard and mustache, and an angular facial structure with high cheekbones. His white shirt is dirty, with a wide neckline that dips below the frame, and his skin appears shiny with sweat. The camera focuses on the man from the mid-chest to the mid-forehead, capturing his intense expression as he clutches his jaw and bares his teeth. He looks down briefly before raising the bottle to his lips with his right hand. As he drinks the clear liquid, the camera tilts up slightly to show most of his head. The bottle is angled upward before he lowers it and swallows. The sunlight reflects off the bottle and the man’s right cheek, adding a natural glow to the scene. The camera then tilts down to keep his face in the frame as he glances down at the bottle in his hand with a neutral expression. The label of the bottle is partially visible but mostly obscured by his fingers. The bottle changes shape, becoming more flattened, indicating it caved under the pressure of his hand.

The clip captures a dynamic, handheld close-up shot from eye level, showcasing the man's movements as he progresses. He is wearing a gray, reflective helmet with a navy blue inner surface, a blue cloth covering his head and neck, and yellow reflective sunglasses. His outfit includes a red jacket with gray lining and the visible sky-blue straps of a backpack. A pointy and sharp metal object is peeking out of his back on his right side. As he walks, he continues to speak to the camera, and the reflection of his movement is visible on his sunglasses. The setting is outdoors, with cool-toned, dim natural lighting. The background features a clear, bright blue sky, a rocky mountainous landscape covered with snow, and green, tall pine trees scattered across. The trees stand on a snowy surface with a mixture of brown surfaces and grass. The camera follows the man's movement, capturing the serene yet adventurous atmosphere of the scene.

prompt_en: A close-up of an individual's hands as they prepare a twisted bacon pastry, captured from a slightly high angle and slowly panning left. The person, wearing a black coat with two white buttons at waist level, stands behind a wooden table. Their bare forearms and hands are visible as they handle the food item, which rests on a thin sheet of parchment paper attached to the table. The pastry is long, thin, rectangular, and consists of four layers: a sheet of dough, small green bits, another sheet of dough, and a strip of bacon on top. A few green bits are scattered on the parchment paper.  The individual uses both hands to twist the pastry, starting with the left side and then the right, bringing it to the center of the frame. The scene is brightly lit, with artificial lighting reflecting off the person's fingernails.

prompt_en: A computer-generated video of a Lufthansa Boeing 747 smoothly moving forward on a wet runway. The aircraft, a four-engine widebody jet with a sleek white and blue exterior, features two rows of windows along its side and prominent branding on its fuselage and tail. The landing gear includes main legs with multiple-axle bogies. The plane moves forward at a consistent speed, captured from a front-left angle, showcasing its elegant design and massive scale. The camera performs an arc shot, rotating clockwise from a top-down perspective, focusing on the nose of the airplane as it points towards 12 o'clock. The camera movement initially accelerates, then decelerates back to its original speed, creating a dynamic effect. The scene is set against an overcast sky, with snow visible on the ground near the runway. The runway is marked with yellow lines and white lines, and small vertical structures line its outer edges. The background features several structures on the horizon, adding depth to the scene. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by neutral gray and white tones, enhancing the serene atmosphere. The absence of dynamic activity emphasizes the plane's presence, making it the focal point of the video.

prompt_en: A wide-shot bird's-eye view captures a serene riverside town during golden hour. The river, wide and calm, flows gently between lush green banks dotted with trees and bushes. Two prominent pink rectangular metal columns with diagonal steel cables stand out on the left bank, partially submerged in the water. The riverbanks feature well-maintained grassy areas with occasional scorched patches, and small water bodies are scattered along the right bank, including a U-shaped earth dam wall. A moderately large vessel navigates downstream, leaving a trail of ripples in its wake.  As the camera slowly zooms in, the focus shifts to the expansive town below. The architecture is a mix of light-colored, low-rise residential and multipurpose buildings, with a notable gothic structure featuring a prominent tower standing out. The settlement follows a nucleated pattern, with paths leading from the dammed water body to the town. A forested median strip with tall, clustered trees stretches diagonally across the frame, separating the river from the town. In the distance, the town extends towards a faint horizon under a bronze-blue sky adorned with wispy clouds.  The camera pans left, capturing the expanse of the town and its architectural details, before coming to a stop. The overall scene is tranquil, with the gentle flow of the river and the soft lighting creating a peaceful ambiance.

prompt_en: A Shiba Inu dog on a leash walks along a dirt path by a stunning turquoise lake nestled in a mountainous area. The backdrop features majestic mountains with patches of snow and lush greenery, creating a picturesque valley between them. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight, casting soft shadows on the ground. The two to three-meter-wide dirt path runs parallel to the lake on the right, leading towards one of the mountains. The lake's vibrant blue waters reflect the surrounding mountains and sky, with gray rocks lining its edge.  The dog, with its distinctive curled tail and light brown, reddish-brown, and white fur, trots along the path, its dark nose and leash clearly visible. As it walks, the camera captures the serene beauty of the landscape, including the scattered puddles and the distant figures of two people further down the path. The dog occasionally turns its head, its ears perked up, seemingly intrigued by something off-frame. The person holding the leash, clad in black gloves, a blue long-sleeved jacket, dark brown trousers, and dark brown lace-up boots, steps into view as the dog relaxes. The video begins with a slight Dutch tilt high-angle shot, transitioning to an arc shot as the dog turns and stops, its attention captured by an unseen object. The camera then shifts focus to the person holding the leash, who partially enters the frame, before the dog abruptly shakes its nose twice, causing the camera to make slight random movements.

A dark apron with brown straps and a metal hook is also partially visible on his right side. The background features a prominent hanging gray lamp emitting artificial light, a white pole with black and brown patches, and a brown surface stocked with items in blue, brown, and white packaging. The scene is set against a backdrop of brown and red bricks with visible white binding material.

prompt_en: A man and a black dog are featured in a misty forest trail, enclosed by tall, bare trees and enveloped in light, dense fog, creating a moody and atmospheric setting. The scene is captured in an eye-level medium shot, with a path on the left leading into the distance and grass extending to the right, ending at a cliff. The man, dressed in a black T-shirt, light long sleeves underneath, jeans, a blue headband, and a long beard, stands on the left side of the frame. He holds a stick and the end of the dog's leash in his right hand. The dog, with black fur and brown fur covering the lower part of its mouth and legs, sits in front of him, wearing a brown leather collar with a leash and a metallic chain collar above it.  The camera captures the man and dog in a series of dynamic movements. The man, with brown, waist-length hair tied back in a ponytail, slightly turns left, revealing his face. The dog follows his hand movements with its head, tapping his palm with its frontal left paw. The man leans in, placing his right hand near the dog's face, and then lowers it, pointing down to the floor. The dog lowers its body, sits up, and leans forward. The camera tilts down and slightly tilts up, returning to its random motions. The man raises his right hand and closes it into a fist, prompting the dog to sit back up. He lowers his hand, and the dog raises both of its front paws and swings them toward his right hand as it hangs low. The man stands back up, and the dog returns to its initial position. The entire sequence is captured in a cinematic style, emphasizing the natural interaction between the man and his dog amidst the serene yet eerie forest backdrop.

prompt_en: In an underwater environment characterized by a pale blue hue from the pool lighting and tiled pool floor and walls, two individuals are central to the scene. One is fully equipped in scuba diving gear, including a black wetsuit, mask, and breathing apparatus, while the other is dressed in full ice hockey protective gear in white, yellow, black, and green, including a helmet, shoulder pads, and a jersey with visible logos on the chest and arms. The hockey player stands upright, holding a hockey stick with the end touching the ground. The scene is captured at eye level as the camera moves randomly in a full shot of the individuals.  The hockey player, positioned on the right, holds the hockey stick and looks toward the right of the screen before looking down at the stick and moving it slightly forward. The scuba diver, located closer to the pool floor, holds a camera mounted on a handle and captures the scene. He points to the right of the screen and looks back at the hockey player before raising the camera to his face. Air bubbles rise to the surface from the diver’s breathing apparatus. The scuba diver then looks at the camera he is holding, with bubbles floating up from his mask. The floor of the pool features two navy blue designs running horizontally from the left of the frame to the right and two small metal details on both sides of the pool wall: a smaller square on the wall to the right of the hockey player and a larger circle on the pool wall behind and to their left. The entire color scheme of the scene is blue.

The camera begins with a medium, eye-level shot of the men before slowly zooming out to capture the entire scene, transitioning to a wide shot at a low angle.

prompt_en: A close-up shot of two glass jars filled with roasted chickpeas and a single bulb of garlic placed beside them. The jars, prominently featured in the foreground, are slightly overfilled past the brim with golden-brown roasted chickpeas, each featuring a slightly textured appearance. The peas display a range of tones from light to darker hues of brown. The jars have threading defining their finish. The subjects are placed on a brown, wooden textured surface. In the foreground on the left-hand side is a jar of chickpeas, on the right-hand side is a bulb of garlic with two visibly detached cloves; one of which is prominent within the shot, with its basal plate facing the camera and the second clove is only barely in the frame. In the background is the second jar, slightly centered between the two foreground subjects. The bulb of garlic shows its papery, pale pink outer layer. Its natural texture contrasts with the smooth surface of the transparent containers and the wooden surface. Throughout the video, the camera moves in a pedestal-up motion, capturing the scene from a close-up perspective that emphasizes the contents of the jars and places them in sharp focus against the less-detailed out-of-focus background. At the beginning of the clip, the focus is placed on the foreground jar and garlic clove. As the camera smoothly moves up, the focus changes to the rim and the contents of the container in the back. The background is blurred and indiscernible, with its light, warm colors creating a static backdrop that highlights the subjects. The scene is well-lit, and the warm ambient lighting enhances the golden colors of the chickpeas and the subtle pinks of the garlic. Light reflections are visible on the right side of the jar in the front as well as on the rim of the one in the back. No movement is observable throughout the scene, the camera is the only dynamic element.

prompt_en: A man walks down a cobblestone street at night, carrying large, white rectangular boards under one arm and a portable stereo in the other. The video begins with an eye-level, wide shot of the man entering the middle of the street from the left, dressed in a long, dark coat, pants, and a gray boombox in his left hand, which glints in the streetlights. The setting is an urban street illuminated by overhead street lamps casting a warm glow. Buildings on the left side of the street feature colorful brick facades in pastel pink, bright blue, and light yellow, adorned with doors and windows. These buildings are lined with various potted plants and silver trash bins. A bare tree stands with fairy lights wrapped around it, extending up to a black metal balcony. The street stretches into the background for another block, with street lamp globes lining both sides and dead ends in a white and tan building with softly lit windows. Several parked cars are visible on the cross streets, and a red vehicle passes from right to left. As the frame pans right, the man turns toward the camera and continues to walk, making steady progress toward the viewer. The man's posture is upright, and he appears focused on his path. On the right side of the street, another building displays more plants tucked into an alcove, including a small potted bush covered in a string of red, green, and yellow lights.

prompt_en: The video captures a man engaged in woodworking, set in a workshop environment. The camera moves randomly, providing a full shot from a high-angle perspective, focusing on the man standing and facing left from the viewer's viewpoint. He has short black hair with some graying strands, and is dressed in a dark brown drawstring jumpsuit over a dark blue t-shirt, complemented by a brown wristwatch on his left hand, black-framed glasses, and white shoes. A rectangular white object is tucked between his jumpsuit and t-shirt, and small gray, black, and blue items protrude from his jumpsuit's chest pocket.  Initially, the man holds a large knife in both hands, positioned horizontally in front of his chest. His left hand grips the silver blade, while his right hand holds the brown handle. In front of him lies light brown wood arranged in square sections, with the outer edges circular in shape. He begins cutting the end of a piece of wood by moving both hands to the right and left. As he continues, his left hand releases the blade, allowing him to cut with his right hand alone. A small piece of wood falls to the ground in front of him. Subsequently, the section of wood he was cutting separates from the main piece and falls to the ground. He then grabs the cut wood with his left hand while his right hand slightly lifts the knife.  In the background, a gray floor is scattered with light brown wood chips and red cables. Two individuals are present behind the man: one wears a light blue t-shirt with a black design, dark blue shorts, black shoes with white soles, and gray socks, while the other wears a white shirt tucked into brown pants with a black belt. A gray table filled with cables and yellow and green objects is situated behind the man in the jumpsuit, with two white cups, bottles in green, red, and gray, and white paper on a light brown object beside the gray table. The lighting is bright, reflecting off the knife's surface.

prompt_en: In a slow-motion sequence, a woman's silhouette stands out against a dramatic sky filled with dark gray clouds and vibrant orange hues. The video opens with a medium shot from a low angle, capturing the woman from behind as she raises her arms triumphantly. The camera remains stationary initially but then shifts to a pedestal-down motion, following her as she slowly lowers her hands and turns to her right. Her dark, backless swimwear and flowing hair are revealed as she continues to rotate, with strands catching the soft, dim light. The scene concludes with her body facing the right side of the frame, her head slightly tilted toward the camera, and her arms hanging loosely by her sides. The setting is outdoors under very dim lighting, with silhouettes of mountains appearing at the bottom of the frame as the camera moves. The sky transitions from dark gray clouds at the top to vibrant orange hues in the middle, with a splash of light yellow near the mountains. Scattered clouds with orange edges are visible in the center, while dark gray clouds dominate the right side, and a clearer sky with light gray clouds and subtle hints of yellow is seen on the left.

prompt_en: In a medium shot, a person wearing a black cap backward and a denim jacket walks slowly down the side of a busy road, their back to the camera. Their arms swing naturally as they move, and their head and body sway slightly from side to side. The camera follows them from behind, capturing their relaxed yet purposeful gait. The scene is set in bright sunlight, with snow-capped mountains and an evergreen forest forming a stunning backdrop. The road, to the left of the frame, winds off into the distance, flanked by a low barrier wall painted with a yellow and black vertical line pattern. Several white vehicles travel in both directions on the left side of the road, while others are parked on the right. The sunlight casts hard shadows beneath the vehicles, and the bright daylight reflects off the surfaces of the cars. To the left of the road, small multistory buildings, one brown and another white, stand alongside various signs placed around the scene. The overall atmosphere is dynamic yet serene, blending human activity with the grandeur of nature.

prompt_en: A young man walks confidently down a modern office hallway lined with floor-to-ceiling glass walls on both sides. He has short black hair, a neatly groomed short mustache and beard, and is dressed in a black long-sleeve shirt paired with white pants. His gray socks peek out from under his pants, adding a subtle detail to his outfit. As he moves, he gestures naturally with his hands, occasionally placing them on his sides and extending them forward, pointing towards the camera. Midway through the sequence, he raises his right hand slightly, flipping it upside down, before bringing both hands up near eye level and positioning them near the glass walls. The camera follows him smoothly, maintaining a wide shot at eye level, capturing the entire length of the hallway and the urban landscape beyond.  The hallway features light wooden flooring and is part of an upper floor of a building, offering a panoramic view of the cityscape. The buildings outside display a mix of architectural styles, with some having brown, sloped roofs and others being white and flat. The main building on the right showcases two rows of grid windows, visible through the glass windows on the right. Bright, natural light floods the corridor, casting reflections of the man on the left wall. The sky above the buildings appears overcast and washed out, adding a serene backdrop to the scene. The hallway is modern and minimalistic, with a clean, contemporary design, and the glass walls enhance the sense of openness and depth.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures two individuals seated outdoors, enjoying chips while engaging in conversation. The man on the left, sporting black spiky hair and glasses, wears a dark olive jacket over a blue hoodie. His facial expressions shift between speaking and eating, with occasional glances upward or towards the surroundings. The woman beside him, adorned with hoop earrings and long brown hair, is dressed in a mauve sweater under a purple jacket. She is actively eating chips topped with green ingredients, her focus alternating between her snack and the conversation. Both are equipped with small clip-on microphones clipped to their clothing. Two white takeout boxes rest in front of them, one partially open. The background reveals a blurred urban setting, featuring tall buildings with large windows, a yellow sign, and greenery that frames the subjects. Pedestrians occasionally pass by, their heads visible over the foliage. The scene is well-lit with natural daylight, creating a casual and lively atmosphere.

prompt_en: A serene pastoral scene unfolds under a dramatic sky, featuring five cows grazing in a lush green field. The main focus is on four cows clustered on the left side, viewed from the right, constantly moving their tails and ears as they feed on the grass. One cow stands alone on the right, facing the camera, and also moves its ear and tilts its head up. The cows are primarily brown and white with irregular patches. The foreground is a vibrant green, transitioning to yellow in the middle ground, where evergreen trees and rooftops of various colors line up horizontally. The background showcases a majestic mountain range with snow-capped peaks on the right and rugged, green-covered slopes on the left. The camera captures the scene in an arc shot, highlighting the dynamic movements of the cows and the expansive rural setting. The sky above is a mix of dark gray clouds with occasional lighter patches, adding depth to the tranquil yet dramatic atmosphere. The entire scene is bathed in natural daylight, casting soft shadows across the grass. This wide shot at a high angle beautifully encapsulates the peaceful coexistence of nature and the countryside.

prompt_en: In a medium shot captured at eye level, an elderly man and a young woman stand side by side outdoors during the day. The man, with a salt-and-pepper beard and mustache, wears a white shirt, a dark green plaid vest, and a black scarf draped over his shoulders. He has large rings on both ring fingers and is holding a string of orange beads in his left hand. The woman, dressed in a bright yellow sleeveless top and accessorized with a gold necklace, has her blonde hair tied up and is holding a black DSLR camera with both hands. Initially, they face the camera, with the man’s face slightly turned to his left and the woman’s head tilted in the same direction with her eyes closed. As the camera pans right, the woman partially turns her body to face her companion, who gestures with his left hand, making three clockwise circles in the air with his left index finger pointed up. He then brings his hand down to hold the beads with both hands. The woman turns back to face forward while the man continues speaking and gesturing with his left hand. His facial expressions are animated, and her face has a subtle smile. The background, softly focused, features a cream-colored building with brown doors and a palm tree on a patch of green grass. The bright daylight illuminates the scene, keeping the main subjects brightly lit but in shadow.

prompt_en: A woman walks through an out-of-focus urban setting, captured in a medium-eye-level static shot that initially focuses on her from the left half of the frame, moving diagonally to the left. She wears a pink and purple tartan shirt with short sleeves, white shorts, and a dark band around her left wrist. Her hair is tied back in a ponytail, and a white bag with a large beige and red design hangs from her right shoulder. As she continues her path, the camera slowly pans left and slightly downward, revealing another woman in the foreground, exiting a building on the right. This second woman has dark hair tied back in a bun, wears a tank top with a design partially obscured by a sheer long-sleeved blouse, a pearl necklace, and earrings, and carries a black handbag around her right shoulder. She stops in the center, slightly turned diagonally to the left, facing the first woman. As the camera continues to pan, a man enters from the opposite side and aligns himself with the second woman, standing on her left. He is taller, with dark, short hair, a light-colored top, and a dark strap around his right shoulder. The first woman looks towards him as he approaches.  The scene is set in a modern architectural space with reflective glass surfaces, creating a 1-point perspective. The furthest point of the background is initially on the left, with the building extending to the back and mirroring the surroundings, giving the impression of an enclosed glass corridor. Large green parasols and dark tables and chairs line the tall glass wall, through which one can see a large staircase and two trees. People are seated on the chairs and walking in the background, with more greenery visible further back. The lighting is dim, with daylight reflected in the walls, adding to the subdued atmosphere.

prompt_en: A sleek, modern monorail train glides through a lush, forested landscape. The scene opens with an eye-level long shot, capturing the train's light-gray exterior adorned with green stripes as it moves steadily from right to left. Supported by sturdy pillars, the monorail infrastructure features parallel metallic beams with a smooth underside. The train approaches a dark rectangular tunnel seamlessly integrated into the hillside. Inside the train, passengers can be seen through the windows, with a handicap sign sticker and a stylized "M" sticker visible on the first and last coaches. The train's backside displays three large glass panels, with rain wipers installed and a white sticker featuring a cartoon character holding a rainbow over its head. Inside the operator's room, a person in a white shirt is seen standing. The train's headlights are located at the very bottom of the backside.  The camera pans slightly left for the first half of the clip, then tilts down for the rest, focusing on the side view of the train as it travels past. Below the train, a winding two-lane road snakes through the scene, marked by light orange lines and flanked by safety railings. The backdrop is a vibrant green forest under a bright, clear sky, enhancing the train's smooth journey and intricate details.

prompt_en: In this cooking video, two male individuals are actively engaged in preparing a dish in a small professional kitchen. The chef in the foreground, wearing a white chef's hat with a blue stripe and patterned gray circles, a red uniform shirt with two white stripes in the neck, and sleeves featuring a blue and white logo on the left side of the chest, is focused on frying two pieces of snacks in a bubbling black frying pan on the bottom right burner. He uses a slotted silver spoon to drain oil from the food as he works. Standing behind him, a bald man in the same uniform is closely supervising, occasionally pointing to a silver tray beside the stove. The chef continues to drain the oil, then transfers the food to one of two silver containers lined with white paper towels, which the supervisor points to. The kitchen is functional yet cluttered, with a silver shelf above the stove holding various kitchen utensils like ladles and spatulas, and a large stainless-steel oven with yellow and white labels and ventilation slats nearby. The countertop next to the stove contains glass bottles with pour spouts, a jar with a red cap, and other kitchen essentials. The brown-tiled floor contrasts with the bright natural lighting streaming through large rectangular windows with white frames, capturing the cooking process in a medium shot with slight random camera movement and an eye-level perspective.

prompt_en: A serene landscape showcases a black car driving on a dirt road. The scene opens with an eye-level, wide shot of lush foliage and an undisturbed pathway. On the left, neatly trimmed, short hedges and a tree are visible, while on the right, tall grasses flank the road. The tall grasses on the right side of the road are lush and towering. The sunlight filters through the leaves, casting a dappled pattern on the road. The camera pans right as a large, sleek black SUV enters the frame from the center, moving smoothly down the road. Initially, it is partly obscured by the greenery on the left before becoming fully visible. The car's modern design and shiny exterior stand out, with distinctive vertical LED lights at the front, creating a stark contrast against the natural background. Its wheels and rim have a gray metallic finish, and its bumper is made up of five horizontally lined metallic plates with a white number plate underneath. Sunlight reflects off the smooth body of the car. As the clip ends, the camera slightly adjusts to the left as the car makes a left turn and the dust is kicked up subtly. An angled view of the car's front and left side fills two-thirds of the frame at the end. This outdoor natural setting is well-lit, with the juxtaposition of the modern vehicle within the rustic setting providing a magnificent view.

prompt_en: A vibrant and lively musical performance takes place in a vintage red open-top car adorned with detailed gray metallic accents, light brown boxes, and black instrument cases with stickers. The ensemble consists of four musicians and a charismatic female lead vocalist standing prominently on the vehicle. The lead vocalist, dressed in a bright orange dress with yellow sleeves and triangles on the bottom, matching yellow gloves, red sunglasses, and an orange headband with a decorative piece, sings into a vintage microphone. To her left, a redheaded musician plays a wooden double bass, dressed in a blue skirt, a light blue blouse with white stripes, a dark diamond-patterned vest, and a pink beret. Seated behind the vocalist to her right, a drummer, wearing a dark purple beret and vest, black sunglasses, a green shirt with white accents, and a yellow tie, plays a compact drum set. A saxophonist sits at the rear left, wearing a patterned, pink-toned hat, dark sunglasses, a squared green vest, a blue shirt with white accents, and purple trousers, while a trumpeter sits to the rear right, clad in a cream hat with a purple line and ribbon, a purple vest, a white shirt, an orange tie, and blue pants.  The performance draws a diverse crowd of onlookers—adults and children in casual hats, some gathered near the camera, others scattered in the background, with one individual in dark attire and a blue shirt trailing the car. The setting is rich with classic architecture, pastel-colored buildings with art deco designs, and vintage storefronts, evoking an early-to-mid 20th-century urban atmosphere, possibly in a theme park. The backdrop features blue skies with painted clouds blending into the vintage facades, contrasting with the clear blue sky and green trees lit by the sunlight of the open setting of the real-world surroundings. The camera tracks and zooms in on the vehicle's left profile from different angles as it moves and turns down the street, capturing the dynamic energy of the performance and the lively audience.

prompt_en: The video captures a man performing an exercise routine in a sunlit yard. Initially, the camera focuses on the man from his left side, showing him in a plank position with a stick and a weight attached to the right end. He is wearing a blue t-shirt with black writing on the back, a dark necklace, black shorts, and black sneakers. The vibrant green grass or turf beneath him provides a stable surface for his movements.  As the camera pans left and arcs in a clockwise motion, the man transitions into a dynamic push-up sequence, gripping the stick and maintaining his plank position. His movements are fluid and controlled, showcasing his upper-body strength and balance. His focused expression reflects his concentration and effort throughout the exercise. The sunlight enhances the clarity of the scene, casting clear shadows and highlighting the lush, green environment.  The background features a gray wooden fence with verdant foliage climbing it, adding depth to the setting. Nearby, there are plants situated next to the fence, separated by a short brick barrier. A black and white goalie net and a soccer ball are visible behind the man, suggesting a recreational space. The overall atmosphere is bright and energetic, emphasizing the man's dedication to his workout amidst a serene and well-maintained outdoor setting.

prompt_en: A rustic outdoor cooking scene unfolds under natural daylight, with a black cast-iron frying pan placed directly on a bed of glowing embers and white ashes. The pan contains a bubbling, red, puree-like liquid with partially submerged ingredients, creating a rich and inviting atmosphere. A hand clad in a frayed sleeve holds a large cleaver, skillfully stirring and flipping the contents of the pan with quick, controlled movements. The background showcases a mix of soft natural lighting and the warm glow from the flames, with leaves of various shades of brown scattered on the ground to the right and green vegetation to the left. Vertical tree trunks stand out against the foliage, adding depth to the scene. The camera captures a high-angle, full shot of the skillet, providing an immersive view of the cooking process amidst the serene forest setting.

prompt_en: A semi-trailer truck navigates a scenic road, captured in a wide shot from eye level as it tracks the vehicle throughout the video. The red cab and blue and gray trailer, prominently labeled with a company name, move along a left curve on a paved asphalt two-lane road. The road is bordered by safety barriers on the right, featuring concrete barriers topped with metallic railings. Small orange and white objects are mounted periodically on these barriers. The left lane has a solid white edge line, with a wide shoulder and two rows of broken lane lines, and minimal right shoulder. Dense green forestry lines the roadside, with tall evergreen trees casting dappled shadows. In the distance, a partially snow-covered mountainside is visible under a vibrant blue sky filled with voluminous, textured clouds. The scene is illuminated by bright natural light filtering through the trees on the right, creating deep shadows on the road-facing side of the trees. The camera follows the truck closely, advancing on the curved path in a push-in effect from the left lane.

prompt_en: The video captures a lively music performance on a dimly lit stage, featuring a singer accompanied by a band. The backdrop is a vibrant, digitally rendered display of a stylized beachside building with a pink sky and a large heart-shaped sign reading "MONICA." A tall, reddish-tube man figure stands prominently on the left side of the screen. The singer, with light blonde hair styled in pigtails, wears a colorful, patterned top and accessorizes with multiple earrings, a black spike collar, and a bracelet. She holds a black wireless microphone in her right hand and gestures expressively with her left hand while singing. The guitarist, positioned to her left, wears a short-sleeved black shirt and has short, brown hair with visible earrings. The drummer, located behind the singer, sports a dark, short-sleeved shirt and long, dark pants. As the camera pans right, following the singer who walks backward toward the right, she turns to face the camera, continuing to sing and gesture. Her long painted nails and glittery eye makeup add to her dynamic presence. The camera then zooms out, revealing a keyboard player bopping their head and playing with both hands. A second tube man figure appears on the right side of the screen, and another band member, playing a green guitar, comes into view. The scene is energetic, with the singer's movements and expressions capturing the essence of the performance.

prompt_en: In a brightly lit kitchen, two young men stand side by side, showcasing a baking tray filled with freshly baked cookies. The man on the left, sporting a white, wrinkled short-sleeve shirt and blue eyes, stands casually with his arms resting on a surface out of view. His blonde hair frames his face as he smiles warmly at the camera. The man on the right, dressed in a black chef's coat with a yellow "sorted" patch, actively engages with the camera, holding the tray with his left hand. He gestures with his right middle finger, pointing to the cookies, while speaking animatedly. The camera captures this interaction from a medium shot at eye level, occasionally shifting slightly to follow their movements. The man on the right then picks up a fork and begins to point to the cookies in a circular motion, emphasizing their arrangement. Both men eventually look directly at the camera, with the man on the right lifting the tray higher and leaning closer, as if to highlight the cookies' texture and appearance. The background features a vibrant red refrigerator on the left and open white shelves on the right, adorned with jars, a festive red Santa hat, and shiny red and yellow ornaments, adding a cheerful holiday touch to the scene. The room is evenly lit, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

prompt_en: A close-up, high-angle shot captures a display of vibrant parrotfish on a bed of ice. The fish are arranged neatly with their tails parallel, filling most of the frame. A hand, seen in the right corner with its palmer surface facing the camera, gently adjusts the position of the second fish from the bottom, lifting its head slightly to reveal its structure. The parrotfish exhibit a striking combination of turquoise and orange hues, adorned with intricate patterns and medium to dark purple accents on their bodies. Each fish has a round eye with a light brown outer area and a yellowish ring encircling the black innermost part. The hand then gradually releases the fish, allowing it to fall back into place. The scene concludes with the hand positioned in the right corner, and the fish delicately settling back into its original position. The lighting highlights the luminous sheen of the fish, while the topmost fish appears softly focused against the sharp focus of the rest. The ice is contained within a blue-edged object, adding a cool contrast to the vivid colors of the parrotfish.

prompt_en: A video captures a woman adorned in traditional Indian bridal attire, showcasing intricate jewelry and elaborate embroidery. The scene is illuminated with a medium, eye-level shot that gradually tracks to the right. She wears a luxurious pink and gold sari with heavily embroidered borders draped over her right shoulder. Her shiny, pink, long-sleeved blouse complements the sari, adorned with similar ornate detailing. On both upper arms are golden, embroidered details with blue gems at the top and purple gems at the bottom. Her hair is styled in a neat, low bun, embellished with a traditional headpiece that features rich gold patterns and sparkling purple stones on the right side of her head. On her forehead is a matching piece that covers most of it. Around her neck, she wears a necklace composed of layered sparkles that catch the light with every slight movement. Her makeup, though subtle, accentuates her eyes.  At the beginning of the scene, the woman is seen standing sideways, looking over her right shoulder with a warm smile, and slowly turning to her right as the scene progresses. A black bar comes in from the right of the frame, partially blocking it. Once she has fully turned her body, the smile fades, and she gracefully turns her head back to the left. At the same time, the camera begins to track to the left. The background glistens with twinkling lights that hang on the right of the frame. Above are bright, white lights hung circularly. In the distance, a soft, purple smoke lingers while allowing the gently blurred figures in white to move in the background. Far beyond, the background is entirely black, allowing the figure to stand out vividly.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures two men in military uniforms engaged in a gear adjustment activity outdoors during the day. The man on the left, wearing a grayish-green helmet and dark sunglasses, is facing the camera. He is dressed in a gray military uniform with brown vertical and horizontal straps, a gray shirt, green pouches under each arm, and a country flag patch on his right arm. His left arm is raised at a 90-degree angle, while his right arm hangs lower. The man on the right, with short dark hair and a clean-shaven face, is dressed similarly with an insignia on his left arm indicating his military rank. He has a black watch on his left wrist and a green pouch under his left arm. His hands are positioned near the other man's green pouch, assisting with adjustments.  As the action progresses, the man on the right fiddles with the pouch, while the other man repositions his left arm to facilitate access. Subsequently, the man on the right moves his left hand to the side of the pouch facing the camera, lowering his head briefly. A silver ring is visible on his left ring finger. He then raises his head and pulls part of the pouch upward while looking at it. The background features a clear blue sky with some clouds on the right, and a large gray aircraft with visible propellers is seen in the distance. The horizon is lined with a dense forest area, and in front of it, there is a green grassy area behind a paved area where the soldiers are standing. Other soldiers in similar uniforms can be seen in the background, adding to the bustling military environment. The scene is illuminated by bright sunlight, creating a vivid and dynamic atmosphere.

prompt_en: In this slow-motion footage, a lone figure confidently strides along a winter coastline, navigating the scattered chunks of ice on the black sand. The person, clad in a khaki-green coat, gray pants, and sturdy brown and gray hiking boots, moves with purpose, their arms swinging rhythmically with each step. The bright, clear day is accentuated by the sun casting a soft, dark shadow on their right side, while the fluffy white clouds near the horizon add a serene backdrop. Rolling waves meet the shoreline, their edges lined with icy formations, creating a picturesque scene. The camera follows the person from behind, capturing a medium shot at ground level, emphasizing the textures of the sand and ice. The figure remains centered in the frame, their lower body and shoes prominently featured as they walk towards the water, with the waves on their left. The glacial ice, ranging from small fragments to large chunks, glistens under the daylight, adding to the cold, yet captivating atmosphere.

prompt_en: A close-up shot with a top-down view captures a measuring cup on a black, scratched surface covered with white flour. The measuring cup, large and partially filled with a creamy substance, has a silver handle resting inside, with its top on the side and the front dipped in the ingredients. The surface is scattered with flour in uneven patches, creating a textured appearance. To the right of the measuring cup, a silver cup with a handle extends out of the frame, and flour dust is visible around, inside, and on the edge of both containers. Two pieces of cloth are partially in view: one is a plain white, scrunched up, and the other is black with white striped patterns. On the right, an open transparent jar contains a coarse, beige substance similar to the inside of the measuring cup. The rectangular edge of a flat item is partially visible on the right lower side of the shot. The scene is well-lit with ambient lighting.

prompt_en: A man treks through a picturesque mountainous landscape, walking along a gravel path that runs parallel to a flowing river. He is dressed in a dark green long-sleeve top and bright blue pants, carrying a large black backpack with a red rope tucked under the top flap. A long blue object with a metallic-looking pointed top is strapped in the center of the backpack, and two cylindrical brown, black, and white objects, resembling walking poles, are secured on the sides. The man, with short brown hair and sunglasses perched on his head, walks forward casually, occasionally glancing to his left as he progresses. The path meanders gently, leading toward distant snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. Lush greenery and scattered trees line the path, while the flowing river on the right is lower than the trail, with a short, steep, rocky bank visible. Bright natural lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the man and the stunning surroundings. The camera follows the individual from behind, capturing both his movement and the breathtaking natural splendor. This scene is captured in a medium shot at eye level, emphasizing the serene and adventurous atmosphere.

prompt_en: A medium shot captures a chef in a black chef's coat, black apron, black pants, and black shoes, wearing white latex gloves, working on a dark countertop. The scene includes a tan floor and white walls. The chef is partially visible from the torso down, focusing on a large white tray segmented into multiple compartments, each filled with vibrant yellow spherical shapes. The chef removes the transparent lid of the white tray, revealing the yellow candies. The camera then pans slightly to the left, zooms in, and removes the lid of a clear tray, revealing similarly shaped orange candies with a black dot on each. The background features a variety of tools and ingredients: two molds shaped like the desserts, a small glass bottle with a water-like liquid, two bags labeled "Ecuador" and "Perú," a larger glass jar with another water-like liquid, and a blue food wrap box. The video is shot at a high angle with overhead white lighting, capturing the chef's meticulous process in a medium shot.

prompt_en: A man stands in a forest during the daytime, holding a large wooden pole over his right shoulder. He is positioned in the center-right of the frame, occupying most of the right half of the shot. The man wears a blue shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his forearms, featuring an intricate blue, white, and light blue pattern on the torso. He has dark short hair and visible crow’s feet and forehead lines. The man holds some leaves in his right hand, which he alternates between holding and gesturing with his left hand, touching the right side of his face and then pointing to the plant. He appears to be talking, looking off-screen to the left, and occasionally nods slightly while shifting his gaze down toward the plant. A left hand enters the frame from the left, gesturing toward the plant as the man holds it with both hands. The background behind him is a hillside with dense vegetation; the left side is in the shade, while the right side is illuminated by sunlight, creating a lighter shade of green. Another forested hill is visible in the middle of the background, also receiving sunlight. The camera captures a medium shot from a slightly high angle, with random movements throughout the scene.

prompt_en: In a medium shot taken at eye level, a man and a woman are engaged in an intimate interaction. The man, positioned on the right, has short, dark hair with gray strands on the sides and subtle facial hair. He is wearing a denim shirt layered over a white t-shirt, complemented by round, black-framed glasses. The woman, on the left, is dressed in a black outfit with mesh full sleeves, her long, black hair accented with brown highlights, and some of it clipped at the back. She accessorizes with a triangular, shiny silver earring in her right ear and red nail polish matching her lipstick.  The sequence begins with the man standing facing the camera, maintaining a neutral expression. The woman, positioned diagonally to his right, turns her back to the camera as she wraps her hands around the man’s neck. The man starts speaking, and she rests her hands on his right shoulder, pressing her body against his left side. He pauses, looking up front, and the woman nods. She then speaks, looking straight at the man with her face near his, and the man replies. The woman smiles and kisses him on his right cheek.  The setting is indoors, with soft lighting illuminating their faces. The background is blurred, featuring gray walls and objects on the left and a yellow wall on the right. A square yellow object is visible behind the man on the right, and a rectangular white surface can be seen behind a gray object on the left. A shiny, circular object is noticeable at the lower left corner of the frame. The overall atmosphere suggests a private and emotional exchange between the two individuals.

prompt_en: A close-up shot from a high angle captures a pair of hands wearing transparent disposable gloves, each with medium-length French tips, as they handle a slice of bread. The bread has a golden yellow crust sprinkled with black sesame seeds and a very pale yellow interior with a spongy texture containing numerous small air bubbles. The person tears the slice into two unevenly-sized pieces, with a third of it in their left hand and two-thirds in their right hand. They rotate the smaller piece until its cross section is directly facing the camera, while the larger piece remains tilted up at a higher angle and rests lightly on the smaller piece. The backdrop is an off-white polished stone surface with a marble design. In the background, a partial loaf of bread and two pre-cut slices lie to the left. The scene is well-lit with high color accuracy levels.

prompt_en: A playful border collie with a black, gray, and white fluffy merle coat, brown eyes, and a black and light pink nose is captured mid-stride in a vibrant green field. The dog runs energetically towards the camera, its mouth open in excitement, and its front legs lifted off the ground. The backdrop consists of several dark green evergreen trees, creating a natural and serene setting. The grass beneath the dog is lush and well-maintained, adding to the lively atmosphere. The camera starts with a low-angle shot, panning slightly to the right to center the dog as it approaches. As the dog moves quickly, it becomes slightly blurred, emphasizing its speed. The camera movement is dynamic, with some random motion that adds to the sense of action. The foreground initially appears blurry but gradually comes into focus as the dog gets closer, while the background remains softly out of focus. Warm sunlight filters through the trees, casting a gentle glow over the scene. The dog’s running path slightly curves towards the right side of the frame as it nears the camera. The video concludes with the camera panning slightly right, capturing the dog’s joyful and energetic movement against the picturesque backdrop.

prompt_en: The video captures the artful presentation of a traditional dessert, baklava, in a bustling kitchen setting. The scene highlights a man dressed in a dark gray jacket layered over a crisp white collared shirt, serving as the central figure. He is meticulously plating baklava, showcasing precision and care. At the start, he holds a large, round tray with his left hand, brimming with golden-brown baklava arranged in a neat criss-cross pattern, with vibrant green pistachio fillings adding a striking contrast. The camera captures a high-angle close-up, with the dessert placed on the left side of the frame. Using a long, blue-handled spatula in his right hand, the man carefully slices and lifts pieces of the dessert from the tray. A transparent glove on his left hand steadies the baklava while transferring it onto the spatula. As he simultaneously lifts three pieces of baklava onto a small white plate to the right, the camera zooms out into an eye-level medium shot that reveals the surrounding kitchen setup while maintaining a high angle. He goes back into the right side of the circular dish for another piece, then leans forward and slightly to the right to place it on a further away plate beside three other pieces of the dessert.  The kitchen features a simple, modern setup, with light-colored cabinets and a spacious countertop serving as the preparation area. On the top-left side of the screen, a red-and-white Turkish flag hangs, reflecting against the wall. Underneath the flag, there is a large pile of white and brown boxes stacked in three columns. On the left side of the main countertop, there are three trays filled with desserts and a digital bench scale with a silver platform and a dark gray pillar. Behind the man on the right, another countertop displays three additional dessert-filled trays. Above them, a dark-colored wall is lined with a stripe of blue checkered tile. The camera is shot with random motion throughout, capturing the dynamic environment of the kitchen. The scene is filmed indoors, illuminated with bright, even lighting with warm tones, enhanced by additional natural lighting flooding through the window to the left.

prompt_en: A young boy sits on a light brown chair in an outdoor setting, enjoying a burger. The video is captured in a medium shot at eye level, focusing on the boy who is wearing a gray T-shirt with colorful text across the chest. He looks down toward the bottom of the frame, appearing engaged with his meal. A glass railing stretches along the right side of the frame, and another individual is sitting on the boy's right, with their left arm visible in the frame.  In the next moment, the boy brings a burger close to his mouth from the center-bottom of the frame, holding it with both hands and taking a bite. The person off the frame to the left puts their hand on his back, and the boy then puts the burger down, shifting his gaze toward the camera while chewing. He looks slightly to the left of the frame and brings his right hand in a closed fist to his mouth. A jump cut occurs, and the clip resumes with the same shot and angle, showing the boy's hand near his mouth as he continues to chew and smile. He then puts both of his hands in fists in the air before bringing them close to his mouth while smiling. He begins to talk, making an open-handed gesture with the back of both hands facing the lower left and right corners of the frame. Another jump cut follows, and the boy continues to talk, making a pointing gesture toward the camera with his right hand. He looks to the right and then the left of the frame while doing this.  The background is blurred, showing an outdoor seating area with some greenery, and the environment is urban, with tall buildings faintly visible in the distance on the right side of the frame. An overcast sky is visible, and the camera remains static throughout. The lighting is bright, with soft natural light illuminating the surroundings.

prompt_en: In a medium shot at eye level, two women in traditional attire engage enthusiastically with the camera against a plain beige wall. The scene is captured with a vignetted frame, adding a subtle vignette effect. The woman on the left, adorned in a teal saree with a bronze chain ornament along the lining, wears large bronze earrings and a small round golden nose pin. Her long black hair cascades around her shoulders. The woman on the right, dressed in a pink saree with purple lining and golden patterns, complements her ensemble with a matching purple blouse and a long golden necklace featuring a flat, complex circular pattern pendant. She also wears medium golden bell-shaped earrings and has her black hair combed back, with small white decorations visible behind her ears. Two small white spots are noticeable on her left shoulder.  Initially, the woman on the left turns her face slightly towards the other woman with a warm smile. The woman on the right responds with a pouting expression before both look directly at the camera. The woman in the pink saree initiates the conversation, followed by the woman in the teal saree. As she speaks, the woman in the teal saree suddenly makes a quick, palms-down gesture with her forearms extended outward, accompanied by a wide-open smile and a head shake. The woman in the pink saree glances at her friend. Subsequently, both women lean forward slightly for emphasis, with the camera zooming in a little, capturing their dynamic interaction. The scene is moderately lit, with cool-toned light streaming in from the left side of the frame.

The hand, holding a dark slate blue pencil, begins shading a square on the roof of a house drawn at an angle. The roof is divided into a grid of 25 squares, with alternating squares being filled in to create a checkerboard effect. The hand moves steadily from the upper left corner to the right, then down to the next row, ensuring each square is shaded uniformly. The house, drawn with bold black lines, features two arched windows on the left sections, with the bottom window slightly larger than the top. Simple plants are depicted to the left of the house. As the hand completes the shading, it reveals a walkway leading to the bottom right section, which includes a door and a balcony-like structure with two horizontal lines and spaced vertical lines. The lighting highlights the intricate details of the hand's movements and the texture of the paper. A static shot focuses on the drawing process, emphasizing the precision and methodical nature of the shading.

prompt_en: In a modest, worn-down room with whitewashed walls marred by stains, a woman is cooking. The scene is illuminated by natural light streaming through a window with stained, cracked window sills to the right. A door with see-through panels and a wooden board at the bottom stands in the middle of the room. The camera captures a medium shot at eye level, focusing on the woman who is sitting cross-legged on a colorful carpet adorned with patterns in shades of red, white, and dark blue. She is dressed in a light blue outfit with an open golden vest over it, her dark-colored hair covered with a patterned blue scarf, and she wears a golden-colored bracelet on her right wrist. Her gaze remains fixed on the pot as she carefully handles a steaming round pot with a cloth. The pot is moved from the small green stove, which sits in front of a rusted metal structure with a pipe leading upwards. The woman places the pot onto a cloth on the carpet, and the camera tracks her movement to the left, revealing a collection of wood behind her to the left of the frame.

prompt_en: The video visually explores the interior of an ornately decorated building, employing a tilt-up motion to elevate the viewer’s perspective from the floor to the ceiling. Initially, the high-angle shot focuses on the building’s bright blue and white flooring, which features intricate geometric designs, including a large symmetrical circle at the center. This motif meticulously incorporates interlocking shapes and patterns outlined in a white tone. As the camera tilts, the angle shifts to eye level, displaying a balanced view of the walls adorned with rich wooden paneling embellished with arabesque art and golden accents. Arched windows are strategically positioned along the walls, allowing natural light to illuminate the room. Two structures, prominently displayed at the center-back of the room, one on each side, showcase golden and wooden detailing that complements the entire decor. On the far right, cabinet-like storage areas with similar details enhance the place's aesthetic.  As the camera motion continues, a low angle is introduced, bringing the upper portions of the room into view. The walls of the section feature calligraphic Arabic inscriptions in gold. Along both sides, two levels of balconies are visible, featuring carved latticework and intricate railings that replicate the detailed patterns found throughout the edifice. These balconies are connected by a series of beams that extend upwards. The centerpiece of the video comes into view: a magnificent crystal chandelier hanging from the middle of the ceiling. Its elaborate structure of cascading design features numerous teardrop-shaped crystals that refract ambient light, brightening the entire room. Four small bulb fixtures are nestled within, adding to the softly diffused shine. Once the camera reaches its peak, the dome-shaped ceiling is now partially visible in the frame. It is characterized by a blend of geometric and floral patterns rendered in hues of blue, beige, and wine, and additional windows with slender frames. The video maintains a wide shot throughout the clip.
